notes.title: Investigating Issues with v.3.5.0.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are investigating several issues that have come up after the v.3.5.0.0 patch, including those making dungeon and raid content difficult or impassable. We are also aware of issues with certain skills that we will look to address as swiftly as possible.

We apologize for the unexpected problems and we will be sure to update you as soon as we are able to get these issues taken care of. Thank you for your patience. 

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: March 27th Maintenance Cancellation/Patch Rollback Compensation
notes.notes:
To all players,

We here at Bless Online would like to apologize on the cancellation and roll back of March 27th maintenance and update. 

Maintenance cancellation and Patch rollback was due to server instability and patch performance issues.

Once we have more detailed information, we will make a formal announcement of the changed schedule to the v.3.5.0.0 patch update through our communication channels. 

Source of the issues are being patched and thoroughly reviewed by our Bless Teams and will be announced along with the rescheduled patch update.

And to express our sincere apologies, we will be compensating our users for the inconveniences.

[h1]Qualification[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Users who have logged in to the game 12 hours prior and after of the initial maintenance extension (Premium, Non-Premium)
[*]Extension on Premium Membership (Applies to users with active membership during the maintenance duration)
[h1][u]Compensation is as follows[/u][/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][b]User Type[/b][/th]
        [th][b]Contents[/b][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Non-Premium Member[/td]
        [td]100 Lumena[/td]
      [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Premium Member[/td]
        [td]100 Lumena + 240 minutes extension on Membership[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[/olist]

Once again, all of us at Bless Online apologize for the interruptions and any inconvenience it may have caused. We'd like to thank all of our supporters and players for their understandings.

Thank you.
Bless Online.

notes.title: Cancellation of March 27th Maintenance and Update Rollback
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

All of us here at Bless Online would like to express our sincere apology to our users in regards to the unexpected maintenance extension and with a heavy heart announce that there will be a[u] [b]rollback of March 27th v.3.5.0.0 patch[/b][/u]

During our maintenance, we have encountered a [u]critical issue[/u] regarding our servers and all of our teams here at Bless Online are working around the clock to locate the source of the problem and have it resolve as soon as we can.

[b]Brief Summary of March 27th maintenance is as follows,[/b]
[olist]
[*]Regular maintenance has been cancelled and rollback of March 27th update is complete

[*]We have also sent [u]100 Lumena[/u] to our players to be used in purchasing Skill Reset Scrolls for our March 27th update. Since the update has been [u]cancelled[/u], the Lumena [b]can be used freely at the player's discretion.[/b]

[*][u]And for those affected by the incident, we will initiate our compensation   process[/u] and can expect compensation by March 29th 2019.
[/olist]

We will inform our users as soon as our team has new developing news in regarding today's issue along with updated release date for the v.3.5.0.0. patch.

Again, everyone here at Bless Online apologize for the unexpected issue and again, thank you for your understanding.

Bless Online

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/61da12976c39f28c996d5c9a155cbbe417538135.jpg[/img]
Greetings Bless Online Community!

The long awaited class balance update will be coming to Bless Online on March 27th! 

The update will feature numerous changes requested by the community such as PvE/PVP balance changes, providing each class with a new 5th set of skills, as well as improve many basic features of Bless Online such as dismantling, dodge and skill chaining mechanics, and player inventory size.

Below is just a small preview of the new tactics added for each class for the upcoming update!
[i] *Please note that tactic names are subject to change and may differ in the actual update. [/i]

[table]
[tr]
[th]CLASS[/th]
[th]TACTIC[/th]
[th]TACTIC FEATURES[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]

[td] Tactic specialized for a balance of attack and defense [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Ranger[/td]
[td]Survival Instinct Tactic[/td]
[td]Tactic specialized for survival[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Paladin[/td]
[td]Wide Area Tactic[/td]
[td]Tactic specialized for wide-area effects[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Assassin[/td]

[td]Tactic specialized for long-distance control and survival[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Berserker[/td]

[td]Tactic specialized for closing gaps[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Mage[/td]
[td]Mixed Elements Tactic[/td]
[td]Tactic specialized for party and raid support through the use of multiple elements[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]

A more detailed list of upcoming changes can be found in the March Producer’s Letter here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1794027541528582071 

We will continue to monitor your feedback on the balance update and make additional changes after the update if necessary.

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] The Upcoming Balance Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/765a16afb7901bd5e59708c99eabd29d43f5434e.jpg[/img]

Hello to the Bless Online community! It’s hard to believe it’s already March, isn’t it? In the last update in February, we introduced the new Urdaata War Fortress dungeon, along with some fun costumes and hats. Coming up next this month will be even more exciting things for Bless.

We know many of you have been asking for balance changes to PvP and PvE. We’ve been listening and gathering feedback from the community, and soon it will be time to implement the improvements. In addition to these changes, we will also be adding a new class skill set for each class.

[b] PvP/PvE Balance Changes [/b]

[i] [All Classes] [/i]

[list]
[*] [u]Dodge Skills[/u]
For all classes, we will be improving the normal dodge-type skills, so that they have priority and can be used even when a character is in the midst of using another skill. Guardians and Paladins will also be able to interrupt their dodge skills. The skills affected include:
[/list]

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Guardian[/td]
        [td]Guardian's Faith[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Berserker[/td]
        [td]Dodge Move[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Ranger[/td]
        [td]Dodge Move[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Paladin[/td]
        [td]Endure[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Assassin[/td]
        [td]Shadow Charge[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Mage[/td]
        [td]Blink[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[list]
[*] [u]Skill Progression[/u]
We will be making modifications to skill progression and growth to make skill growth more rewarding. We felt previously that the effects gained from growing skills felt somewhat insignificant - now skill progression should feel better and more satisfying.

[*] [u]New 5th Tactic[/u]
A new 5th tactic will be added to expand the possible variety of combat experiences for each class. The Guardian’s new tactic, “Guardian of Darkness,” will be balanced between attack and defense. The Ranger will get the new “Survival Instinct” tactic, unsurprisingly focused around survival. The Paladin’s “Wide Area” tactic will contain skills meant to be used over large areas. The Assassin’s “Throw” tactic is centered around keeping long range attackers in check and survivability. The Berserker’s “Charge” tactic focuses on closing the gap, and the Mage’s “Fusion Element” tactic is a versatile set of skills that are best put to use supporting a party or raid group. Please keep in mind that the tactic names have not yet been finalized!

[*] [u]Skill Chaining[/u]
After the balance update, if a player misses during a skill chain, the chain will continue to increase regardless. Additionally, if a player uses a normal skill during a skill chain, the chain will no longer break.

[*] [u]Dismantling[/u]
After the update, the dismantling functionality will be improved so that multiples of an item can be dismantled at one time.

[*] [u]Expanded Inventory[/u]
We will be increasing the amount of inventory slots available for players’ convenience.
[/list]

[i] [Guardian] [/i]

[list]
[*] For the Guardian, we heard feedback and saw for ourselves that the class needed a damage buff. As such, we will be increasing the damage dealt by several of the Guardian’s skills. 
[/list]

[i] [Paladin] [/i]

[list]
[*] For the Paladin, we recognized that the healing from Sacrificial Plea greatly overshadowed the healing done by other healing skills, and players were relying too heavily on just Sacrificial Plea. To combat this issue, we will be reducing the healing amount and increasing the HP penalty of Sacrificial Plea, and increasing the healing amount of Beacon of Healing.
[/list]

[i] [Ranger] [/i]

[list]
[*] There will be several important changes made for the Ranger. First of all, we will be making it easier to smoothly sequence skills. Previously, there was a problem where skill sequencing could be difficult due to the player having insufficient Concentration. To help alleviate this issue, we will be reducing the Concentration consumption of certain skills and increasing the amount of Concentration gained from certain tactics.

[*] We will also be changing each tactic’s chain skills, so that each tactic is made up of skills that fit best with the tactic’s characteristics. One example of these changes is that we will be switching in some skills into the Swift Attack Tactic that are more suitable for the theme of “attack and retreat.”
[/list]

[i] [Mage] [/i]

[list]
[*] For this magic-wielding class, we will be modifying the mana recovery rate so that greater benefits are gained from class-appropriate armor. When a Mage equips all robe-type armor, their mana recovery rate will be higher than it was previously. In addition, if a Mage has non-robe type armor equipped, their mana recovery rate will be lower than it was before the changes.
[/list]

[i] [Assassin] [/i]

[list]
[*] We will be changing how the damage is distributed throughout chained skills. Previously, damage was distributed fairly evenly between the Chain Start Skill, the middle Chain Skill, and the last Chain Skill. After the balance changes, the expected damage value done by the last Chain Skill will be higher than the Chain Start Skill or the middle Chain Skill.

[*] We will also be raising the amount by which certain effects or benefits are increased (proportionally to Mark of Death) at the end of an Assassin’s chain skill. For an example, if before the balance change update an effect was “increase Malevolence by 2 proportionally to Mark of Death,” the Malevolence after the March update might be increased by 4 instead of 2.
[/list]

As you can see, there’s a lot to look forward to in March! We can’t wait to hear all of your feedback on the new changes once you’ve had a chance to test them out.

Until next time,
Woo-Young Jung
Executive Producer

notes.title: Daylight Saving Time Changes
notes.notes:
Dear Players, 

Since the Daylight Saving Time will soon be applied, we’re planning to reflect the required time changes to the game. We are planning to update the game texts simultaneously for both servers. 

Please note that the times specified in game might still appear as PST(Pacific Standard Time) or CET(Central European Time) even before or after the DST(Daylight Saving Time) starts as it is applied differently for each region.

Time Zone converters are available online. Please use them at your own discretion.

We will update you the maintenance date once it is determined.

[h1]DST(Daylight Saving Time) changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] NA: March 10 at 2:00 am PST(Pacific Standard Time)
[*] EU: March 31 at 2:00 am CET(Central European Time)
[/list]

[h1]In-game Texts[/h1]
[list]
[*] Siege of Castra, Peninsular War, Capital War, Certanon Arena schedules will be updated to PDT(Pacific Daylight Saving Time) for the NA region and CET for the EU region during the scheduled maintenance.
[/list]
[h1]Attendance Check Texts[/h1][list]
[*] As we already announced in the March Login Event announcement, DST will be shown starting April 1st. 
[/list]

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Urdaata War Fortress
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/363a0918bb14d193de4e813e93991db2204b613f.jpg[/img]

Greetings to the Bless Online Community!

Coming up on February 20th, we will have an exciting new update for you all to enjoy!


[b]New Urdaata War Fortress Dungeon[/b]

Get ready to fight your way through the Urdaata War Fortress. This new level 50 dungeon has a group size of a maximum of 10 players, and can be entered once per week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4fa7af33d1454d12053fc437762b4c6a4a31a06c.png[/img]

Those brave enough to enter will have to battle their way past a host of deadly bosses, including Corrupted Aelia, Ikichi, and Lava Golem Maglam. For their efforts, players can be rewarded with Rings and Necklaces with useful effects, Rare or Heroic Armor and items, Enhancement materials, and more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/80868f27a3e26fd7415da8dbad2e6b30cacdeafc.png[/img]

If they vanquish the final boss, Karata, they can receive Rings, Legendary Weapons, Rare or Heroic Armor, Magic, Rare, or Heroic Spirits, or Figures.


[b]New Cosmetics[/b]

Along with the new dungeon, several new cosmetic items will be available, including the regal Winter Sky costume set for 2600 Lumena, and three new leopard print headband hat items for 400 Lumena each!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a135c135a17db14b1ab733a4505535c87d731864.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/baa3199d9b1c0b061581ee8bf26f33a2af5d9af2.png[/img]


[b]Future Updates[/b]

As we have been working to determine our update cadence and prepare new content and improvements for Bless, we saw that some of the community felt there has been a lull in our communications. Rest assured, more updates are in the pipeline and we are still working hard on improvements and updates for the game!

Additionally, look for a Producer’s Letter later next month; it will have some exciting details about the next update we have planned. We’ve been listening to your feedback and have some changes in the works that we think you’ll be excited about.

For now, you can focus on training for your face off against final boss Karata in the Urdaata War Fortress!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

[h1][Rift of Space and Time][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Reward box will be generated if the first relic is protected at the end of the 5th round / 10th round / 15th round / 20th round of the Rift of Space and Time.
[*] The HP of the relic from Stage 3 of Rift of Space and Time will now be displayed on the left UI.
[*] Balance has been adjusted as follows:
[/olist]
[*] Season 1: No change
[*] Season 2 : When attacking a crystal, the increased Fighting Power and Ability Power effect that was obtained will change from 100% to 50%.
[*] Season 3: Modified the HP and Fighting Power of summoned enemies and allies.
[*] Season 4: Added a function that restores HP by 10,000 when the Dimension Chaos effect is added.
[/list]

[h1][Modified Content][/h1]
[olist]
[*] The minimum level required to use Anima has been changed from Level 33 to Level 8. The in-game guide quest has also been changed to Level 8.
[*] The Ruber’s Ossuary and Zeeto’s Laboratory dungeons can now be accessed twice a day.
[/olist]

[h1][Events][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Basel Gorge Event started:
[list]
[*] The player will obtain a Basel Gorge Certificate of Valor if they complete Basel Gorge daily quests or defeats monsters in Basel Gorge. Lucky Chests can be crafted using the collected Basel Gorge Certificates of Valor. Lucky Chests also have a chance of dropping from defeated Basel Gorge monsters.
[*] The Basel Gorge gift box types include food boxes which gives various buffs, 2018 Year-End Lucky Chests which contain temporary flying mounts, weapons, and crafting materials for armor, and a New Year’s Celebration Lucky Chest which contains weapons, costumes, and crafting materials for accessories.
[/list]
[*] Winter Festival Event ended
[*] Hot Taming Event ended
[/olist]

[h1][Special Currency Shop][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added a “Hats” tab to the Special Currency Store and 6 types of hats to that category.
[*] Added the “Snowfield Buffalo Set” costume to the Special Currency Store.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8be0dd9012adc0f2a71b8f03fde533c249f91c2b.png[/img]
 
[*] Added the “Changing Drakaru” mount costume and the “Walking Lollo” pet costume to the Special Currency Store. 

[b][Changing Drakaru][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/94006b2448e0a6f08374ecf84252cf6dbfa4b743.png[/img]

[b][Walking Lollo][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/e35e4fa82fbeac2525fac293c95a7414db91b154.png[/img]

[*] Added Ruru Brother’s Magic Pocket to the Special Currency Store.
[*] Added Mount / Pet Anima items to the Special Currency Store, which can now be used by players Level 8 and over.
[*] Added NPC summoning items to the Special Currency Store.
- NPC summoning items can be summoned from the Market / Personal Chest / General Merchant / Blacksmith and can be either valid for one use or permanent.
[/olist]

[h1][Improved Functions][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Improved the UI where the Passive Effect was displayed.
- Emphasized the outline of the icon
- Added the cooldown time inside the icon (number is now displayed)
[*] Added a cancel button to the quest notification UI.
[*] Improved some German translations.
[*] Improved the companion upgrade, item enhancement, transcended enhancement, and enhancement succession visual effects. 
[*] Added a button that brings related menus from the character info into the life tab.
[/olist]

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where a user’s target’s pet disappears when a hostile target uses Stealth.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of “Blue Fog” during the Rift of Space and Time flickered repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal inside a dungeon would be deactivated after resurrecting inside the dungeon if the raid party was killed in the next area after having defeated “Mahabali Statue” in the Patala Ruins raid dungeon.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented players from continuing with a quest since the explanation of the specific royal quest and the text shown in the dialogue with NPCs displayed different info.
[*] Fixed an issue where the message “You can't hold more items” or “You must free up some space in your inventory” would appear and the next quest couldn’t be accepted by the player despite them having enough space in their inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where unselectable icons in the customization window were brightly displayed after a player used a gender change token and entered the customization window.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Market WIC window could not be closed when pressing the ESC key after having selected a text field inside the WIC.
[*] Fixed an issue where using a skill mid-air would force the character to land again.
[*] Fixed a bug where the door of the dungeon wouldn’t open if the dungeon’s special boss was defeated with reflective damage, thus preventing the player from completing it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sealed Mark of the Relic Guardian’s Chest would keep receiving a regeneration effect from the Regeneration Magic Tower, making the player unable to obtain the Marks of Space and Time Chest which appears in the Rift of Space and Time.
[*] Fixed an issue that didn’t allow the player to continue with the Habicht quest.
[/olist]

notes.title: Known issues after the 3.3.1.4 update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have identified an issue with the new Snowfield Buffalo Set which is purchasable from the Special Currency Shop. When this set is equipped by a Mascu character, there’s a bug that makes the character seem as if they're not wearing any costume.

We are currently in the process of fixing this bug and Mascu characters will be displayed normally after the fix is complet. We expect to resolve this issue by January 10th and will make sure to notify players once this is done.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Wise Ones' Mausoleum Dungeon (Elite)
notes.notes:
[b]Wise One's Mausoleum Dungeon (Elite)[/b]

On January 9th, the new Wise One's Mausoleum (Elite) dungeon will be added to Bless. This level 50 dungeon has a recommended party number of 5, and an entrance limit of once per day. The entrance location for both Hieron and Union players can be found in the Wise One’s Ruins inside the Elemental Forest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6fec80050821523c1b2ed7be05c08b0946682f6d.png[/img]

Fight your way past the denizens of the mausoleum to do battle with final boss Liche Tiberius! A variety of rewards can be earned from the mid bosses and the final boss, including crafting materials, Rare Spirits, a legendary helmet, and more. 


[b]Basel Gorge Certificate of Valor Event[/b]

The first in-game event for 2019 will be taking place in Basel Gorge! Starting after maintenance is complete on January 9th, players will be rewarded with Certificates of Valor when they defeat monsters in Basel Gorge or when they complete Basel Gorge daily quests. Players can then use the Certificates of Valor to craft a variety of gift boxes. Gift boxes also have a chance to drop directly from defeated monsters in Basel Gorge. Gift boxes may contain buff effect foods, weapon skins, temporary flying mounts, or various enhancement materials!


[b]Sales[/b]

On January 9th, the Special Currency Shop will be getting an update with some new items, including Anima Random Boxes, Ruru Brother’s Magic Pocket (The resource dungeon turban item), and portable NPC summoning items called Popochita On-Demand Service (single use and permanent item versions for summoning the Market, Personal Chest Manager, General Merchant, and Blacksmith).

Nine new cosmetics will also be added to the Special Currency Shop, including the Snowfield Buffalo Set (pictured below), which includes the costume as well as the Charging Drakaru mount skin and the Walking Lollo pet skin.

The other six cosmetics are the hats for players to purchase and wear contained in the newly added “Hat” tab of the Special Currency Shop!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c9e60ea558b02f28e6691eaa0d050bdb6c90f7ef.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b4370c721b5948db6b02c2101e36ef100c978263.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a3616bbbbdde0f9a18c255114373159328897b10.png[/img]

2019 has only just begun, but there’s already a lot to look forward to!

Happy New Year,
The Bless Team

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*] After the maintenance on 12/12, we discovered an issue with the legendary equipment crafting recipes which can be purchased from the Master Smelter NPCs. We have dealt with the issues as follows:

- Recipes
   : Recipes registered in the shop: Deleted
   : Learned recipes: These recipes will still appear on the list even though they will be unusable. These recipes will be removed from the list later on (when these items are updated, the deactivated recipes will appear normally on the list and will be usable for crafting).

- Crafted Items
  : Items crafted with learned recipes: Deleted
  : DP and items used when crafting: Recovered and sent through mail (will be sent in order after maintenance ends).
  : Enhancement material items used when enhancing items subject to deletion: Will be restored and sent via mail (to be sent in order after 12/14).

[*] Legendary grade accessories (rings, necklaces, etc.) that could be obtained but not crafted were removed from the merchant NPC and from the crafting list. When learning a recipe, there are no materials or goods to be recovered because no materials or goods were used.
[/olist]

notes.title: Bless Online v.3.2.0.1 Patch Note
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2eff556ac9786740eeef8cc897a65ca8ab3c9838.jpg[/img]

[b]Bless Online v3.2.0.1 update[/b]

[h1][Rift of Space and Time Expansion][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Expanded Content and Rewards
[list]
[*] Added an extra stage to the existing 2 stages (there are now 30 rounds total).
[*] Due to the addition of a new stage, added an extra mission that requires the player to defeat a mid-level boss and the final boss in the middle of the third stage.
[*] Added new bracelet items which have a chance to be  obtained when defeating a boss monster in the 10/20/30 rounds.
[/list]
[*] Modified Difficulty
[list]
[*] Increased the difficulty of rounds starting from the 6th round (no change in difficulty for the first 5 rounds).
[/list]
[/olist]

[h1][Korean Language Support][/h1]
[list]
[*] Korean support will be added; players will be able to change the language to Korean in the launcher.
[/list]

[h1][Additional Functions][/h1]
[olist]
[*] A confirmation pop-up will now appear when trying to click on the exit button in the Rift of Space and Time.
[*] Added an option in Settings that doesn’t show other players’ pets.
[*] The locations of the teleport and healing zone in the Rift of Space and Time will now be marked on the map.
[/olist]

[h1][Improved Functions][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Improved visibility of the available amount of Lumena in the lobby.
[/olist]

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*] The Hieron area “Juicy Grapes” quest can now be done.
[*] Fixed an issue where a character’s hair would stick out from the hat when the Protector of the Pirate Codes Captain’s Hat is equipped.
[*] Players will now be able to do the 2 weekly missions “Tame a rare grade mount” and “Tame a rare grade pet” instead of the ones referring to an undisclosed dungeon.
[*] The following items, obtainable after defeating the bosses at Ruber Ossuary, will not be tradeable now:
- Various potions (Elixir of Combat Enhancement, Excessive Fear Stimulant, Weird Elixir, Elixir of Elem Defense Disarmament, etc.)
[*] Among the special options for weapons, 2 of them had different effects but the same name and were unstackable. Fixed this issue so that even if the effect is applied to one weapon, it may be stacked. However, stacking is not possible if both the name and effects are the same.
[*] Fixed an issue where the visual AOE range of the “Earthshaker” skill used by Sulla Ruber in the Ruber Ossuary dungeon don’t match with the place where players can receive the actual damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Storm Trooper’s Bracelet’s options would be maintained even after equipping other bracelets.
[/olist]

[h1][Winter Festival Event][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Winter Festival Event will start after the December 5th maintenance.
[/list]

[h1][Special Currency Shop][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Special Currency Shop Discount Event will come to an end after the December 5th maintenance (however, the discount on Looting Pets will still be ongoing).
[*] Added the [Snowflake Winter Festival Set] costume.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/bdf8b143690747fb0f52c16caa406543dce2af86.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1][Others][/h1]
[olist]
[*] The Market fee discount event will come to an end after the maintenance on December 5th.
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy the update! While you're at it, check out our ongoing [url=https://gleam.io/c5ATC/bless-online-sweepstakes]Gleam campaign[/url] and enter to win some awesome prizes!

notes.title: [Update Preview] Rift of Time and Space Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6dea2df140867b5aa6a1afb59a5b83358353132d.jpg[/img]
Next week, on December 5th, we will be adding some never-before-seen content to Bless Online on Steam!

[b]Rift of Time and Space[/b]

After temporarily closing on November 7th, the Rift of Time and Space will be reopening with a brand new third stage! This expansion will take RoTS to a total of 30 rounds (previously 20), add a new area, and will also see the addition of new stage rewards: bracelet items that give additional effects to the wearer!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/61d806c14cc68da54266da058791bdd2b18762e6.png[/img]

This new third stage has never been released before in any region, so Bless players on Steam will be the first to try it out! We can’t wait to hear what you think.


[b]New Holiday Costume[/b]

In the spirit of the holiday season, a new festive costume will be added to the Lumena Shop! The Snowflake Winter Festival Costume can be purchased for 2600 Lumena.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6f18a0024957fcecae50391316a50bed9ce32a41.jpg[/img]

You are sure to bring holiday cheer to your fellow players with this new costume!


[b]Korean Region IP Unlocked + Language Added[/b]

With this update, the Korean region will be unlocked, and players from that region will be able to enjoy playing Bless on Steam! Korean language support will also be added at this time. We are thrilled to be able to support our Korean players in this way following the discontinuation of the KR Bless Online service, and we look forward to them joining Bless Online on Steam.


[b]Holiday In-Game Events[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/09f210a0104aa2fe84b009d634147960832a584a.jpg[/img]

This December, starting on December 1st and running through December 31st, we will be holding a Festive December Login Event! During this time period, players will be able to get a variety of great rewards, including the Ruru Brother’s Magic Pocket item that allows players to summon the Rand Brother Turban and access the special gathering and mining area within it. 
 
To get rewards, all players have to do is log in to Bless, click on “Collect Daily Rewards” in the Check Attendance window, and get the rewards on the character of their choice!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6e625642aef731467311e0c106c5072b0b768f59.jpg[/img] 

In addition to this login event, starting on December 5th after the update maintenance, the Winter Festival Event will be taking place in game! There are three interconnected quests for this festival event, and players can complete each of them once per day. During these quests, players will have to make sure the festival celebration goes off without a hitch by collecting the Light of the World Tree, helping citizens with their wishes, and more!
 
Each quest comes with a special reward, including a temporary flying mount, firecrackers, and consumable items.


Wishing you a happy holiday season,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Known issues with the 3.1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have identified some issues with the 3.1.0.1 update.

[olist]
[*]There is an issue with one of Sulla Ruber's skills, Earthshaker, where the actual damage received by the character might differ from the visual AOE range. In other words, even if the character is located outside the damage range, they might still receive damage. There is a chance players will encounter this issue when facing Sulla Ruber.
[*]We are also aware that an an in-game announcement (Bless Black Friday Deals - DLC Sales, Lumena Shop Discounts, and More! (up to 60%)) is being shown in-game even though most of the discounts have yet to be applied. We have removed the announcement to prevent further confusion.
[*]Although the Rift of Space and Time is supposed to open on December 5th, the icon is still being shown on the map. Players will not be able to enter before December 5th.
[*] If a user sends mail using a character whose name has been changed, when the receiver of the mail opens it, it will say that it is from the character's previous name (the name used by the sending character before their name change). 
[/olist]

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and we will make sure to fix this issue during the next update.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Ruber Ossuary Level 50 Dungeon + New DLCs
notes.notes:
[code] Please note that we have encountered an issue with the planned discount for the DLCs, as such we will not be able to run the sales on the new DLC packs as planned. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.[/code]

Greetings to you all!

We hope you have been enjoying the big level 50 update, and have been leveling up your characters and exploring all the new areas and stories! Very soon, on November 21st, we will be adding even more new content.

In addition to another new level 50 dungeon, Ruber Ossuary, we will be adding two new DLC packs, three different looting pets for purchase, and we will also be running a 20% off sale in the Lumena shop! 


[b]New Dungeon - Ruber Ossuary (Normal)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/df32bfdfe214ada9b95206d581e9ed184bd46daa.png[/img]

In the update, we will be adding the brand new Ruber Ossuary dungeon! The entrance will be able to be found in Rosso’s Mansion in Terny City for Union, and in the Timorris Abandoned Mine in the Elemental Forest for Hieron. Players will be able to enter it once per day, and must be level 50 to do so. A five-person party is recommended to tackle this challenge, as players will be facing down a variety of nefarious bosses! 

In the depths of Ruber Ossuary, Sulla’s resting place, players will come face to face with mid-level bosses such as Mutant Osis, Magum the Evil Spirit Sorcerer, and Chief Priest Bursty. The Final boss of Ruber Ossuary is Sulla Ruber. From defeating these bosses, players have a chance to receive a variety of valuable rewards.


[b]Serpent Squire and Dragon Knight DLC Packs[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/53faadd0665afb9b00ce756631a1d99cd0a1e41c.jpg[/img]

The two new DLC packs that will be available for purchase through Steam contain items valuable for both beginning adventurers and veteran warriors! We will be running special DLC release discounts as well, so that the Serpent Squire pack, normally priced at $14.99, will be available for just $9.89! It comes with the items listed below:

[list]

[*]Mirror Ball Watcher Looting Pet
[*]500 Lumena
[*]Inventory Expansion Ticket (8 slot) x 1
[*]Companion Growth Potion (1 Hour) x 5
[*]Nutrition Refreshment for Pets (1 Hour) x 10

[/list]

The second DLC, the Dragon Knight pack, is reduced in price from $59.99 to $39.59 during the release sale! It comes with the following skins and items:

[list]

[*]Dragon Knight Costume
[*]Dragon Knight Mount Skin
[*]Dragon Knight Pet Skin
[*]Revenant Commander Nale Looting Pet
[*]7900 Lumena
[*]Inventory Expansion Ticket (8 slot) x 4
[*]Extra Tactic Save Ticket x 1
[*]Companion Growth Potion (1 Hour) x 10
[*]Nutrition Refreshment for Mounts (1 Hour) x 20
[*]Nutrition Refreshment for Pets (1 Hour) x 20

[/list]


[b]New Looting Pets[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/3e741477c746f646a8bdc935f3f8a2b817a8e627.jpg[/img]

Three looting pets will now be available for purchase in the Special Currency Shop! These pets are rare, level 10, permanent auto-looting pets that come with one auto-looting skill; this skill is fixed and will not change when using the Companion Skill Change Token. These pets come with an Upgrade Attempt count of 10, and each looting pet has a special look that hasn’t been seen so far in the Steam version of Bless. 

The Mirror Ball Watcher, Dragon Sprite, and the Revenant Commander Nale looting pets will be available for a discounted price of 800 Lumena in the shop, and the Mirror Ball Watcher and Revenant Commander Nale pet will also be available in the new Serpent Squire and Dragon Knight DLC packs, respectively. 


Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Exploit Fixes, Reparations, and Clarifications
notes.notes:
After the update, we applied a hotfix Wednesday (3.0.0.1) to address a few issues that arose, and we want to make sure the community is aware of the steps we took! Further actions to resolve the exploit were taken on Thursday.

In 3.0.0.1, most importantly, we fixed the exploit introduced in 3.0.0.0 through which players were able to purchase green items from the NPC vendors and dismantle them for enhancement materials (Pieces of Ymir’s Skin). The probability of obtaining materials when dismantling Magic grade items purchased through NPC vendors has since been reduced to negate the exploit.

We also fixed the issue where players could run Zeeto’s Laboratory more than once per day. No more living in Zeeto’s lab, folks, sorry! 

On Thursday, we took actions to resolve any unfair advantages gained by players due to the exploit that was hotfixed in 3.0.0.1.

[b]Actions:[/b]

[olist]

[*]All players who abused this bug had their items removed.
[*]If the items were unable to be removed, they had their market access taken away, and have been sent an in-game mail with instructions on how to remove their market restrictions.
[*]Players must either collect the required items so we can remove them from their account, or pay an approximate gold value for the items they acquired through this exploit. Users who are unable to return the proper number of items, or pay for the items will be given the option to have their upgraded items removed from their characters in order to regain access to the market.

[/olist]

We also wanted to clarify some points of the patch notes regarding the new level 50 dungeon (Zeeto’s Laboratory) that may have led to confusion among players.

In the patch notes, due to the wording, some players thought that only level 50 players could now enter Siege of Castra, Arenas, and Peninsular War. However, the entrance requirement level for these have not changed; upon entering these areas, the player’s character will be scaled up to level 50 (rather than level 45, as was the case previously) for the duration of the instance. We have adjusted the patch notes now as well to better reflect this meaning.

We hope this helps clarify any confusion, and we will continue to update you on future changes!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Changes in friend list after the 11/7 update
notes.notes:
Hello, players

Bless Online's friends list will be improved on November 7th (Wednesday) as specified below.

Before the change, players would be added to another player's friend list without the other party having to accept the friend request. Now it has been changed so that the other party must accept the friend request to be added on each other's friend list.

Players' existing friend lists will be reset due to this update.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you,
The Bless Team


UPDATE:
Only the friend list of players who haven’t added each other will be reset. (e.g.: If two players add each other, both players’ friend list will remain as is. However, if a player has added another player unilaterally, the latter will be deleted from the former’s friend list).

notes.title: [Update Preview] The Ruins of Shaqqara
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8c07206114a2c3edf69335124511a53207dc41fa.jpg[/img]

Greetings to the Bless Online community!

Official launch seems like only yesterday, but we’re already moving on towards our next big update on November 7th! We wanted to give you a look at the upcoming update that will contain not only a level cap increase to 50, but a new raid, gear, quests, and more!


[b]Level 50 Increase[/b]

Anyone who already has characters at the former level cap of 45 will be extra excited about the new level 50 cap! They, along with everyone else who has a bit further to go, will be able to continue growing their characters through new areas, story quests, and hunt quests. As the level cap will be increased, all characters will need to be at level 50 to participate in Royal Quests, which will appear randomly each day. 

Union players will continue their story by journeying to request help from the Pantera King, while Hieron players will have to forge their way to meet with Great Chieftain Chinuwa in Lupuscana. 

The new areas added include the Burning Desert, a sweltering and unforgiving wasteland rife with monstrous creatures, and Shaqqara, a mysterious zone filled with ancient ruins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ef2633f9d098731dae8bc2d0505be0ee6c8ce096.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8dda453580b1cc75fa2b8fb945369de9f1ad338c.jpg[/img]


[b]New Dungeon - Zeeto’s Laboratory (Normal)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/36b285e6f1cbf842f7e3811173c08aff8af8ab68.png[/img]

Zeeto’s Laboratory is a level 50 dungeon that players can enter once per day (again with a recommended group number of five). Players can enter Zeeto’s Laboratory in the Forbidden Area of the Polluted Forest. Inside, players will track down Zeeto himself and uncover the secret behind the underground laboratory!

Players will not be able to proceed through the dungeon unchallenged, as standing in their way will be mid-level bosses Zeedraco, Elem, Chikeekee, and Cimon! The final boss duo consists of Zeetatan and Zeeto. Players will be able to potentially get Spirit Harvesting Skills (1 Hour), Rare grade armor from the Aspiring weapon series, Hero grade armor from the Corrupted series, armorsmithing materials for the Corrupted series and Aspiring series, and crafting materials for the Legendary Mount Zeetatan.


Of course, besides all of this awesome new content, you’ll also be able to look forward to quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and more in game events for November! So… Who is going to be the first to level 50?

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Item Enhancement Changes in the 11/7 Update
notes.notes:
In addition to all the new content being added in the update on November 7th, there will also be some adjustments made to item Enhancement. To best prepare you all for the upcoming changes, we have shared the details of the changes below.

Our goal with these changes is to make it easier for player to navigate the Enhancement system and know where to use the Enhancement items that they obtain, thereby making the Enhancement process more streamlined and intuitive.

[b]Changes[/b]

[olist]


[*]Condensed Magic Stone will no longer be used as an Enhancement material, and instead will be used only as a Crafting material. Ymir's Horn and Piece of Ymir's Skin will replace Condensed Magic Stone as Enhancement materials. 

[*]All existing Enhancement materials currently in game used to enhance levels 1-10 or level 11+ can now be used for all Enhancement levels (1-15+), including pieces acquired through disassembling.
[list]
[*]The amount used for Enhancement will vary from material to material.
[*]Unlike before, the type of Enhancement materials used will be available in three different grades and the success probability differs between them.
[*]For example, the probability of success will be higher when using Sturdy Skin of Ymir than when using Piece of Ymir’s Skin to enhance weapons and equipment.

[/list]

[*]Items excluded from the current list of Enhancement materials are as follows:
[list]
[*]The Condensed Magic Stone, which used to be a main Enhancement material, will no longer be used for Enhancements. Advanced Enhancement materials will be used just as before during Crafting.
[*] Players no longer need Sword Body of Flogas / Contorted Wings of the Beyond / Contorted Horn of the Beyond / Contorted Nail of the Beyond to prevent a decrease in Enhancement level for those items. Instead, general Impurity Removers have replaced these specific items, and can be used on any of the equipment. These Impurity Removers can be acquired through disassembling any of the items listed above.
[*]The current Kindle of Urgand can be used for Transcendent Enhancements.
[/list]

notes.title: Bless Online Official Release Date and F2P Model Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Bless Online players! 

Today we have some very exciting news to share with you, so let’s get right to it!

[b]Bless Online Official Release October 23, 2018[/b]

First, Bless Online will be officially releasing on October 23, 2018! We can’t wait to show you the improvements and content we have been working on for the launch. 


[b]Bless Online Goes Free to Play[/b]

Second, at full release, Bless Online will be going Free-to-Play, as we believe that model will provide the best experience for all players at official release. We intend to introduce as many people as possible to the feature-complete form of Bless Online. After several months of Early Access development and invaluable feedback and support from our Founders, players, and community members, Neowiz is ready to launch Bless Online this fall as a Free-to-Play experience. Those individuals who have previously purchased Bless Online will be provided in-game rewards marking their contributions to the game.

As a gift of appreciation to all our founders who supported Bless through Early Access, we will be giving rewards based on purchased game pack tiers.

[table]
[tr]
[th]REWARD TIER[/th]
[th]REWARD ITEMS[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Base Game[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Standard Edition[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Deluxe Edition/Deluxe Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]180 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Collector’s Edition/Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]Lifetime Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/e9848ac5ecef0ac1b7b4ede4d155d85edbd8c6bd.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ce43b6b5f371eb53ba05a322914fcb707436f162.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/44de783bbdea27dafc3b2fecd6035942abd243da.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a6f8a77022a49245997a14a2494a946e884ffb16.jpg[/img]

We also plan to provide special weapon skins to Early Access players who return to Bless within a specific period of time after the official release. 

We hope that all our players will enjoy these rewards for their immeasurable support as they continue in their Bless Online experience into the official launch and beyond!


[b]Patala Raid Raid Update and Halloween Content[/b]

Today we released a new update containing the completely new Patala raid. In it, a party of up to 10 players can enter and test themselves against the 6 bosses contained within the dungeon. Players must be level 45 and have a minimum gear score of 8913 to enter, and can do so once per week. 

Rewards for defeating the various mid-bosses include Ananta's Flame, Contorted Wings of the Beyond, Contorted Chain of the Beyond, and the Animosity armor series. Rewards for defeating the final boss of Patala include the Sword Body of Flogas, the Storm weapon series, and new legendary level 45 weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c7e32ac601805a90a766dc8cf698b94f8d9b19d0.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we are adding new Halloween-themed costumes for players to wear in the spirit of the season! Starting today, October 4th, players can also participate in the Halloween in game events, which consist of 5 quests that ask players to defeat pumpkin-headed enemies, collect candy, and much more for special rewards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ea8289cfcc6ee1c3c97e09f879ffd31155249c.jpg[/img]

As you can see, there is a lot to enjoy and look forward to in Bless in the coming days, weeks, and months. As always, thank you for your time and support! We look forward to seeing you out there in the world of Bless Online.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Patala Raid and Halloween Events
notes.notes:
Hello, players! With a new update coming next week, we wanted to give you all a look at what exciting content is in store.

[b]Patala Raid[/b]

First up is a brand new raid! This dungeon is for a maximum of ten players in a raid party, and can be entered by talking with the NPC Anahrata, the Patala Ruins Seal Guide, near the entrance of the ruins. Players must be level 45 and have a minimum gear score of 8913 to enter, and can do so once per week.

Players will encounter six bosses within the dungeon, including the final boss Ananta, who can drop rewards such as the Sword Body of Flogas (a material for enhancing weapons), the Storm weapon series, and new legendary level 45 weapons. The mid-bosses drop other rewards, including Ananta's Flame (a material used for crafting Lvl 45 legendary armor), Contorted Wings of the Beyond and Contorted Chain of the Beyond (materials for enhancing armor), and the Animosity armor series.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c7e32ac601805a90a766dc8cf698b94f8d9b19d0.jpg[/img]


[b]Halloween Events[/b]

In addition to the new raid, it’s spooky season! We know you love this time of year, and so do we. To celebrate it, we have a whole bunch of themed events for you to take part in Bless!

The October login event will be running from October 1 - October 31, and players who log in for fifteen days will be able to receive 50 sapphires, 350 rose stones, and 230 beryl! For logging in and getting an Attendance Check on the other fourteen days, players will be given a variety of rewards including magic pet and mount animas, pet and mount skins, Nutrition Refreshments, a companion skill change token, and more! Further details about the event will be released soon.

In-game, things are even more festive! The Halloween events will be held from October 4 - November 7th, and during that time players can participate in several different quests.

[i]Jack-O’-Lantern Event[/i]

Players can find the NPC to start these quests either in the Noble’s District Cemetery inside Hieracon (for Hieron) or in the Cemetery Park in Spezia (for Union). From there, players receive the first quest, Memories of the Ghost Festival, and are asked to collect several appropriately themed items to complete the quest, including a scary mask, a knife, and candy. Players are then rewarded with a Scary Ghost Festival Set that includes a mask and costume.

The second quest, Preparations for the Ghost Festival, asks players to gather pumpkin items. Players who complete the quest will get a 30 day Scary Ghost Festival mask.

The third Jack-O’-Lantern quest, Festival Lights, requires players to defeat certain dungeon bosses (who will be sporting pumpkins on their heads) and collect Flames of Souls from them. Upon quest completion, players will receive a Jack-o'-lantern Lucky Box.

[i]Witch Raven Event[/i]

Witch Raven, the NPC for this quest set, can be found in Skaa Village for both Hieron and Union players. The first quest, Candy or Corn, asks players to collect Cursed Candy by defeating monsters in the Cornus region who drop the item. Once players collect the candy, they will be awarded the Insightful Lens From the Other World that they will need for the next quest,  and 10 Greater Taming Scrolls.

For Mysterious Rumor, the next quest, players will need to use the Insightful Lens From the Other World to begin. This will allow them to see a new NPC in the Cornus Valley that they must defeat. After attaining victory and turning in the quest, players will get a 7-day Creepy Skull Horse mount.

 
In the final quest, Visitor in the Dark, players must succeed in the Kuat Ran raid, after which they will be mailed items that will allow them to craft a Witch’s Lucky Pouch. Upon turning this item in to Witch Raven, players may receive either a Witch’s Lucky Pouch or a Handkerchief with the Breath of the Battlefield.

[i]Other Halloween Treats[/i]

Additionally, during the Halloween Event time, players may acquire pumpkins at random when gathering. They can then use these to craft Scary Ghost Festival Masks. NPCs may also randomly spawn when players are gathering, and if the player successfully tames them, they may obtain a Magic Rare pet at random. These tameable NPCs can also spawn during the fight with the Mysterious Rumors NPC if the player succeeds in bringing the NPC’s health below a certain level.

As a bonus, all throughout the Halloween event, if players die, they will receive a pumpkin head rather than resurrection after effects.

We look forward to seeing you all showing your Halloween spirit with your new costumes! We don’t think anyone will “boo” your new looks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ea8289cfcc6ee1c3c97e09f879ffd31155249c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [Update Preview] - Rift of Space and Time & the Random Dungeon
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b3a2655bded6dd02047c8fc6a03a8c00fb87a403.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

We’ve been hard at work on the next update to Bless Online, and today we’ll spend a few moments talking about the coming update (v2.1.0.0), set release on Sept. 5th! The focus of this update is new level 45 content: Rift of Space and Time, and the Random Dungeon.

[b]Rift of Space and Time[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/dbc909861f41d3f93b242e23c69651e191b51a53.jpg[/img]

The Rift of Space and Time offers players a new type of end-game quest: a wave defense challenge featuring two stages with differing maps, random monster waves, and a whopping 20 rounds! Better yet, this challenge is one of the ways to obtain a new type of equipment, bracelets!

Bracelets can be obtained by completing related quests, killing boss monsters, and as a ranking reward in Rift of Space of Time. The efficiency of bracelets can differ depending on the acquisition method.

Rift of Space and Time is available for players to queue solo or in a party of three, and requires players to guard a relic which the ensuing monster waves will be intent on destroying. Monsters will appear from various parts of the map (so check your six!), and differ with each round. Once a round is cleared, new monsters will then appear.

Upon clearing rounds, players will receive Marks of Space and Time, which can then be used at the Shop NPC to obtain items such as Summon Scrolls. Summon Scrolls will come in handy when executing your strategic gameplans to clear all 20 rounds! But beware, Marks of Space and Time cannot be cached, but will instead disappear upon completion of the Rift of Space and Time, or simply when the instance ends; so use them while you have them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5f56a0a594ae3438afa9da37bb04de7bafd46272.jpg[/img]

Those of you who manage to defeat the boss that appears at Rounds 10, and another at Round 20, will be guaranteed one of two bracelets (different depending on rounds cleared)! What’s more, players who place in the Top 10 will receive a set item that will 100% generate a bracelet. 

How do you place in the Top 10, you ask? At the conclusion of each attempt, players will receive a personal and overall rank, letting them know how well they’re performed. Performance will in turn determine the Challenge Points awarded to that player, which can be used to purchase the material Fighting Spirit Magic Stone from the shops around the Rift of Space and Time to then upgrade your bracelet. So perfect your strategy, execute flawlessly, and place yourself amongst the best of the best for sweet, sweet loot!

[b]Random Dungeon[/b]

The Random Dungeon is a new dungeon matching option that provides level 45 players the opportunity, twice per day, to solo-queue into dungeons (excluding raid dungeons) for a shot at looting Pure Moonlight Powder, Mysterious Mount Lucky Boxes, Mysterious Puzzle Lucky Boxes and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c4dc6cfb2164c2d1655b9e33febbbcd7f158adde.jpg[/img]

If you and your fellow dungeoneering compatriots successfully defeat the final boss for the dungeon you are in, you will receive said dungeon’s standard rewards, in addition to any of the possible rewards provided by the Random Dungeon.

So what are you waiting for?! You’ve got your work cut out for you, now go forth and enjoy!

Thank you,

The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Reflections on the Update, Future Adjustments, and Upcoming Emissary Applications
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]
Greetings, players!

[b]The Assassin Update[/b]

We hope you all have been enjoying the the Assassin Update that released earlier this week, as well as the discounts, giveaways, and in-game events going on to celebrate it! The team is excited that they were able to finally share the content for the update that they have been working so hard on.

We know that the urgent maintenance that took place after the update inconvenienced many of you, and we apologize for that, though it was necessary for server stability. However, we would like to give you all a gift of 500 Lumena as compensation for the issues caused. Additionally, those with active Premium Membership buffs will receive a one hour extension on them; you can read about the compensation details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1701684721089094438)] here.	[/url] The Bless team will continue to do their best to ensure server stability.

We have been tracking numbers, and are happy that you all are enjoying Siege of Castra! The first siege was completely full, with hundreds of players in queue. As such, we are going to be expanding the number of channels for Siege of Castra so that even more players can enjoy it. In order to provide the best player experience for the number of participants, our developers are currently monitoring the situation in order to prepare for opening another channel.

We also heard your feedback that you didn’t like runes/spirits breaking. As such, we plan to include an update in the near future so that runes/spirits no longer break in Peninsular War or Siege of Castra.

We have also heard reports of some issues with the Assassin’s skills. We investigated this, and discovered that there was an issue with one of the Assassin’s skill tooltip translations. We did a minor patch last night to address the issue,and also fixed the bug where players were not able to select other members of their raid party in this patch. We are also continuing to monitor feedback regarding class balance, especially for the Assassin, and will take such feedback into account for the next overall class balance patch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0b90d2a16f93d480975c54a59fe8e57fa290c9d.jpg[/img]


[b]Emissary Applications[/b]

In the coming weeks, we will be reopening Emissary applications. We have been making some exciting changes to the program behind the scenes, and will look forward to welcoming new members to a refreshed, restructured experience. Keep an eye on our social channels:

[url=https://twitter.com/BlessOnline] Twitter	[/url] 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/BlessOnline/] Facebook 	[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/e39ZygQ] Discord 	[/url]

 for more news on the next round of applications later this month, as they will only be open for a limited time! However, keep in mind that even if you aren’t selected for the next round, there will be future opportunities to join the program.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6e1a0b0be93c119f7c993b1ada21c48dd35e8b6f.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, but we’ll have more news to share as we move towards launch!

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9c656093d61e6194486bc79930d8fece68f5e06a.jpg[/img]

[b] Bless Online v2.0.0.0 update [/b]

[h1][New Character Class - Assassin][/h1]
Attacking from the shadows, meet the stealthy Assassin class [url=https://youtu.be/qyX8rVk61mA]here[/url]!
https://youtu.be/qyX8rVk61mA
[olist]
[*] Added the new "Assassin" character class

i. Concept:
Assassins are masters of stealth and guile, so watch out; if you let your guard down you may find yourself poisoned, ambushed, or just quietly stabbed. Assassins are often focused on one thing and one thing only: the elimination of their target! If you allow one to sneak up behind you, you may not live to regret it.

ii. Races that can be played as Assassin:
- Hieron: Habicht, Sylvan Elf, Mascu
- Union: Amistad, Aqua Elf, Pantera, Mascu

iii. Recommended equipment and suitable materials:
Recommended Equipment: 
* Weapon: Dagger
* Armor: Light Armor, Medium Armor

- If appropriate armor for the Assassin class is equipped, the beneficial effects provided can differ according to the number of equipped pieces and player level (under / over Level 30).
* Defense Effect : Increase in Dodge rate
* Attack Effect : Increase in Fighting Power, Critical Hit rate, and Critical Hit damage

iv. Targeting Mode: Compatible with both Action-targeting and Tab-targeting 

v. Tactics:
- Main Stances:

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Stance[/th]
	[th]Name[/th]
	[th]Characteristics[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 1[/td]
	[td]Assassinate[/td]
	[td]An assassination type stance that focuses on attacking the enemy from behind.
- Damage is increased if attacking from behind.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 2[/td]
	[td]Withstand[/td]
	[td]A combat type stance that focuses on fighting enemies from the front.
- Increases  normal Attack Power.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 3[/td]
	[td]Raid[/td]
	[td]A surprise attack type stance that focuses on quickly attacking the enemy from behind.
- Increases Critical Hit after a movement skill.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 4[/td]
	[td]Poison[/td]
	[td]A poison stance that covers the enemy in poison.
- Inflicts additional damage to enemies with [Poison] or [Venom].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 5[/td]
	[td]Throw[/td]
	[td]A long range stance that focuses on attacking the enemy by throwing daggers. 
- The skill after a throwing skill will be a critical hit.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 6[/td]
	[td]Execute[/td]
	[td]A finishing stance that gets stronger the lower the enemy’s HP is.
- Increases the damage of Last Chain Skills.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

- When the Mark of Death is stacked to the maximum, consume it to maximize stance switch effects.
* Players must utilize the effect where the amount of the Mark of Death is returned based on the amount consumed. 
* Since the main way to obtain Malevolence is by switching stances, players must continually switch stances to manage Malevolence.

[/olist]

[h1][New Content - Siege of Castra][/h1]

[olist]
[*] Added Siege of Castra.
- Large scale (maximum 70 vs 70) PvP content available during scheduled times that divides players by faction (Hieron and Union) to determine victory.

[b] i. How to Join / Event Details: [/b]

- Players can register to join beginning 10 minutes before the start time through the War UI in the system menu.
- If there is an imbalance between participants in both factions, there will be queues. Players enter the game in order of their queue number.
- Players can join starting at level 25. Their level will be scaled to 45 upon entrance.
- It will last a maximum of 30 minutes. The faction that defeats the opposing faction’s Lord Commander NPC within 30 minutes wins. If no one defeats the Lord Commander NPC within 30 minutes, the match will end in a tie.
- The schedule for Siege of Castra is as follows (4 times daily):

[NA region] *PDT
[table]
[tr]
	[td]10:00[/td]
	[td]14:00[/td]
	[td]19:00[/td]
	[td]22:00[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[EU region] *CEST
[table]
[tr]
	[td]01:00[/td]
	[td]13:00[/td]
	[td]17:00[/td]
	[td]22:00[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[b] ii. Main Rewards [/b]

- Players may earn Combat Points depending on their level of contribution while participating in Siege of Castra. The winning team will receive more rewards than the losing team. Also, players who received quests from NPCs within the battlefield will receive additional rewards upon victory.

[b] iii. Main Objects: [/b]

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Name[/th]
	[th]Characteristics[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Purifying Tree[/td]
	[td]A vindictive spirit is summoned if players knock down the Purifying Tree. The vindictive spirit is allied with the faction that knocked down the Purifying Tree. It will then summon “Corrupted Plant” underlings and charge towards the enemy faction’s door or Lord Commander NPC.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Guardian Stone[/td]
	[td]The Guardian Stone is created 2 minutes after the battlefield’s vindictive spirit spawns and belongs to the faction that knocked down the Purifying Tree. When the Guardian Stone is destroyed by the opposing faction, the vindictive spirit will disappear, and the faction that destroyed the stone will receive an Attack Power, Ability Power, and Movement Speed increase buff.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Artillery[/td]
	[td]There is artillery that protects each faction located in each faction’s headquarters. These automatically attack approaching/ invading characters from the enemy faction.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[/olist]

[h1] [Additional Content - Dominion Contract (DC) and Capital War (CW)] [/h1]

[olist]
[*] Dominion Contract:

- Dominion Contract refers to the contract that grants the authority to rule over specific territory within the affiliated faction. The guild leader of the guild that succeeds in the Dominion Contract will become a Baron or Governor and their guild will become eligible to participate in the Capital War, which is where the Guardians of the Faction are determined.

[b] i. How to Join / Rules [/b]

- The Dominion Contract is awarded through the Auction and the guild that successfully bids last will win the territory.  
- Dominion Contract lasts for 40 minutes, and guild leaders can make a bid by using their total amount of Guild Influence points.
- The bidding fee is 10% of the guild’s Guild Influence Points and guild leaders will get 90% of their Guild Influence Points (excluding the 10%) back if their bid fails. Players can also bid extra amounts as much as they want even while the auction is ongoing. Additional bids can be done at a 10% or more of the previous bid price.

[b] ii. Schedule [/b]
- The Dominion Contract and Capital War will each be held once every 2 weeks, alternating every Saturday (e.g. 1st and 3rd Saturday = Capital War, 2nd and 4th = Dominion Contract).

- First Dominion Contract to start on August 11th (Saturday).
* NA: 18:00~18:40 *PDT
* EU: 21:00~21:40 *CEST

[b] iii. Areas available for Dominion Contract [/b] (5 per faction)

- Hieron: Lupuscana, Floren, Marta, Curia, Ostium
- Union: Navarra, Migdal, Campagna, Terny, Shaqqara

[b] iv. Main Rewards [/b]

- Rewards obtained when winning a Dominion Contract bid
* If you win the bid and end up owning territory, you also obtain Reign Points (RP).

* Guilds are rewarded with 2000 RP per territory
[i] * What are Reign Points? Reign Points are Activity points or EXP that can be obtained by players of the same faction in the same area controlled by a Baron or Governor. Players can check their Reign Points by going to the Guild menu [H]. Items can be purchased using Reign Points in the Reign Point Reward Shops through the Imperial Secretary or Federation Secretary who are located in the big cities. [/i]

- Reign Points obtained by winning a territory
* Guilds occupying a territory due to the Dominion Contract will receive RP daily.
[i] * 1 territory per day will earn the guild at least 1000 RP and a maximum of 3000 RP per day [/i]

[*] Capital War:

- Capital War is the battle to determine who will be the highest rank (Protector Marshall or High Praetor) in their respective faction. The roles are divided into offense and defense. Each faction’s Baron or Governor can join at a specific time to try to become the Protector Marshall or High Praetor, or form an alliance and contribute to the Capital War’s defense.

[b] i. How to Join / Rules [/b]

- Only the guild leader and guild vice leader of DC winning guilds that own a territory may request to join the Capital War, but once their request is accepted, the whole guild may join. Players can apply for the CW an hour before it starts for a period of 30 minutes (17:00~17:30 PDT / 20:00~20:30 CEST) or enter the battle by talking to the Capital War Manager NPC in either Hieracon or Spezia.
- Capital War lasts for 45 minutes, and within that time players must either protect or contest the Guardian Statue. If one succeeds in both defending and attacking then they will be rewarded with Reign Points and rewards.

[u]* First Protector Marshall / High Praetor Reward:[/u]
After the first Dominion Contract on August 8th, the guilds which won the DC and spent the highest amount of Influence Points will become Baron / Governor(Only the highest amount that was successfully bid for a territory will be taken into account). They will be automatically selected as the first Protector Marshall / High Praetor. The first Protector Marshall / High Praetor will not receive a reward for the Capital War. The Protect Marshall / High Praetor guilds that were appointed during the first Dominion Contract will participate as a defense alliance in the first Capital War on August 18th. After the first DC, the High Praetor / Protect Marshall will be decided depending on the outcome of the Capital War.

[u] * How the first Capital War will proceed: [/u]
The CW winner(Protector Marshall / High Praetor) can only defend while the remaining DC winners(Baron / Governor) may choose to either defend or attack during the Capital War. The CW winning guild may retain its position if it succeeds in defending, but if the attacking side succeeds, the guild leader who is successful in the interaction after the Guardian Statue is destroyed will become CW winner.

[b] ii. Schedule [/b]
- The Capital War takes place once every other week at the following times:
- First Capital War to start on August 18th (Saturday).
* NA: 18:00 - 18:45 *PDT
* EU: 21:00 - 21:45 *CEST

[b] iii. Main Rewards [/b]

- Rewards obtained when becoming the Capital War winner
* 20,000 RP will be rewarded to the winning guild
* A mount costume will be rewarded to the winning guild and guild members:
(Hieron: Guide of Honor (1 day), Union: Guide of Freedom (1 day))

- Rewards obtained while CW winner status is maintained
* A statue of the Protector Marshall / High Praetor guild leader will be erected in each faction’s capital city (Hieracon / Spezia). The statue will change if the Protector Marshall / High Praetor guild leader changes.

* Players may additionally obtain a set amount of the total amount of RP earned while they are still reigning over the territory. 
[i] The CW winning guild can obtain a minimum of 3000 to a maximum of 7000 RP [/i]

notes.title: [Update Preview] The Assassin, Siege of Castra, and Dominion Contract/Capital War
notes.notes:
Hello, players of Bless Online!

With the August Assassin update only a few days away, we wanted to give you a look at what’s in store for you! In addition to the new class, the Siege of Castra and Dominion Contract/Capital War content will be available.

[b]Assassin Class[/b]

With this next big update coming August 8, we will be adding the Assassin class! Players of both factions will be able to play as the Assassin. On Hieron, the Habicht, Sylvan Elf, and Mascu can take on the role. On Union, the Amistad, Aqua Elf, Pantera, and Mascu are able to try their hands at assassination.

In addition to these faction and race options for the Assassin, players will be happy to know that the class is compatible with both action-targeting and tab-targeting combat modes.

This new class will have many fun new skills and stances for players to experience. Different stances encourage different styles of play, such as the Assassinate stance that increases damage dealt when the target is attacked from behind, or the Poison stance that deals additional damage to enemies afflicted with Poison or Venom! Each Assassin player will want to try a variety of tactics to see what they like the best.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0b90d2a16f93d480975c54a59fe8e57fa290c9d.jpg[/img]
The recommended equipment for Assassins will be the dagger and either Light or Medium armor. For wearing armor suitable for their class, Assassins will get certain bonuses depending on how many pieces of suitable armor they are wearing and what level they are. For example, an Assassin above level 30 who is wearing all Light armor will get bonuses to Dodge Rate, Fighting Power, Critical Hit Damage, and Critical Hit Rate.


[b]Dominion Contract/Capital War[/b]

We’ll also be introducing Dominion Contract and Capital War! A Dominion Contract is a the contract that grants the authority to rule a specific territory within a faction. Dominion Contract bidding periods last for 40 minutes, and only guild leaders are able to place bids using Guild Influence. The guild leader that has the most Guild Influence wins the bid will become a Lord, and they and their guild will be eligible to participate in the Capital War. Those who lose the bid will get back 90% of the Guild Influence used in bidding.

Dominion Contract and Capital War will each be held once every two weeks, alternating every Saturday (for example, if the first and third Saturdays were Capital War days, then the second and fourth Saturdays in a month would have Dominion Contract instead). The times for Dominion Contract is as follows:
[list]
[*]NA: 18:00~18:40 (PDT)
[*]EU:21:00~21:40 (CEST)
[/list]

The available territories to bid on for Hieron are Lupuscana, Floren, Marta, Curia, and Ostium. The available territories for Union are Navarra, Migdal, Campagna, Terny, and Shaqqara.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/eba5b01b8a86e98675b6d5bbd4ea3564b094caa2.jpg[/img]
Guilds also earn a reward of 2000 Reign Points per territory won through a Dominion Contract bid, and they will earn 1000 Reign Points per day each day that they occupy a territory. While the territory is under their control, Guilds will also get additional benefits, and will be able to earn up to 3000 Reign Points per day depending on the amount of EXP, Combat Points, and Dungeon Points within the occupied territory.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8fcb180471e618bff4d46c723d0b40fa85159574.jpg[/img]
The Capital War is the battle that determines who holds the top rank of Protector Marshall or High Praetor, depending on the faction. 

Of course, only guilds that own territories are able to participate. These intense fights take place over the course of 45 minutes, during which time players must either protect or attack the important Guardian Statue. The guild that is able to both successfully attack and defend the statue is granted 20,000 Reign Points and other rewards such as temporary prestige mount costumes.

Laboratory (Mascu race) cinematic.

Professor Dafne before completing the “Missing Professor” main quest. [/olist]

[h1][Event][/h1]
