notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Upcoming Content and Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]
Greetings, dear Bless Online players!

The team has been working hard on addressing your pressing issues as well as bringing you new content. Next week on 7/18 you will get to experience the Migra Turis (Elite) content! Other changes and content will be coming very soon as well, and you can read a bit about it all below.

[h1]Upcoming Content and Changes[/h1]

[b]Migra Turis (Elite) Update[/b] (7/18)

We have added a new level of difficulty to Migra Turis, which comes along with new rewards! Amongst other adjustments, players will now have a chance to obtain a Level 45 Heroic weapon from defeating the final boss, Flamelord Fogas. 

[b]Dungeon Drop Rate Changes (Coming Soon)[/b]

We know you all have been asking for a change in the dungeon drop rates. So, sometime soon after the 7/18 update, we will be hugely increasing the drop rate by doubling it. Further adjustments may still be made to the drop rate after we hear your feedback on the changes, so please let us know after you’ve tried it out!

[b]Combat Targeting Mode Changes[/b] (Coming Soon)

Many of you have been asking to have the option to switch targeting mode for different classes. As such, we have been working to bring you more options. In the next change to the targeting mode options, you will be able to switch between modes with all classes except the Berzerker and Paladin, which will still be locked to action targeting and tab targeting respectively. As the Paladin needs to use tab targeting to effectively heal and the Berzerker skills were optimized for action targeting, we have not yet been able to give both mode options to these classes that resulted in a positive player experience. We will instead be adding a target tracking function for the Berzerker (and the other classes as well) that we think will address many of your issues.

[b]Balance Changes[/b] (Coming Soon)

One major focus for the balance changes is PvP. We are making adjustments to the classes in ways that we think will contribute to a better PvP experience. We look forward to hearing your feedback after you have tried out the changes, as balance is always an ongoing process.
We are also working on PvE balance to improve the feel of each class in group play; amongst other things, we are working on buffing the aggro-holding ability of the Guardian.

Though we are working to bring you this new content and new improvements, we are also still working to address other big issues that you have brought up, such as optimization and additional balance and bug fixes. We appreciate the feedback that you continue to give us, and will keep using it to make Bless Online even better as we move towards launch.

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Update Preview - Royal Quests and Basel Gorge
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers! 

The team has been busy working on the next update to Bless Online, and today we wanted to spend some time talking about that update (v1.3.0.0) as it will be released on July 4th! The focus of this update is new end-game content: Royal Quests and Basel Gorge.

[b]Royal Quests[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/10477c2f03dd6ea3e82352b50a8788aa3bfd84bc.jpg[/img]
Royal Quests are a new daily quest series that will be available to characters starting at level 45. Players will be able to find an accept these quests in multiple locations around the world; they will be marked by purple quest icons on the world map. Players will be able to complete a total of 15 Royal Quests per day to get the most rewards possible.

These quests have better rewards than regular quests! Not only does each Royal Quest have a higher gold reward than a normal quest, but for every 5 Royal Quests completed each day, players will receive an additional bonus reward via in-game mail. 

[table]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 5 times[/th]
[th][Luxury] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 10 times[/th]
[th][Rare] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 15 times[/th]
[th][Hero] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

The top tier [Hero] Royal Box even has a small chance of dropping rare pets and mounts.

[b]Basel Gorge[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/48dd85b85938416c536359063bfce5cc62965519.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4188036341038178c88f52a763222bf9d653ab47.jpg[/img]
Basel Gorge is the highly contested centerpoint of the conflict between the Union and Hieron factions. As such, it is recommended that players approach Basel Gorge with a party of level 45 characters.

Located to the east of where the Siege of Castra takes place, Basel Gorge has many different gameplay elements for players to participate in. There are two main objectives to compete for with the opposing faction; controlling the three neutral bases and killing the various bosses in the Basel Gorge area. 

While in Basel Gorge, players are able to gain more Combat Points from engaging in PvP than they would in other open world zones by controlling neutral bases. Gaining control of a neutral base will grant all members of that faction currently in Basel Gorge a “Gorge Occupier” buff. 
This buff can stack up to three times, once for each neutral base in the area. Each stacked buff grants a 7% increase in movement speed and increases the amount of Combat Points gained from killing another player by 50%, making faction PvP within Basel Gorge extra rewarding. 

However, keep a close eye on the bases! Once a base is captured, it will only belong to that faction for twenty minutes before it reverts to neutral and can be contested by the opposing faction once again.

Basel Gorge is laid out with Hieron in the north and Union in the south. There are also various teleporters and revive points for each faction spread throughout the map. Bosses spawn towards the middle of the area, with some spawn locations being more easily contested by one faction than the other.

The bosses players will find in Basel Gorge are more difficult than the typical elite bosses that are spread across the world of Bless. There are also three different rarities of bosses, determined by their respawn time and the randomness of their spawn location. Sak the Hobgoblin Fiend and Murderous Rover Sykeeli are the most common; they are on short respawn timers and will spawn at predictable locations throughout the map. Ensanguined Ursuta and the Giant Malefic Blob are on a slightly longer respawn timer and will appear in one of seven random locations around the map. Last, but certainly not least, Spider Queen Akasys—one of the most challenging bosses in Basel Gorge—is on the longest spawn timer and will appear in one of seven random locations when she spawns.

Loot in Basel Gorge works differently than it does in other areas in Bless. Participation in the fight for each boss is calculated to determine the overall contribution of each person in the fight. The more a player participates in each fight, the more Combat Points they will be awarded for defeating the boss. Remember that in Basel Gorge, players are always competing against the opposing faction for credit on boss kills. Loot drops will be distributed via die roll for the faction that successfully takes down the boss.

As you can see, there are many ways to enjoy the new Basel Gorge content. Players can choose to fight difficult bosses, attack bases, defeat members of the opposing faction—or even a combination of the three! We hope you all have as much fun with this new content as we do, and we look forward to hearing your feedback on it.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] The July 4th Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dear Bless Online players!

The focus of today’s letter is new content, changes and improvements that we will be bringing to you in Bless Online very soon. The team has been working hard on things for future updates, and we wanted to share a bit about them with you.

[h1]The July 4th Update Content (v1.3.0.0)[/h1]

We have heard all of your feedback that you would like to see more activities and content added for the end-game, and this update will do just that! We will be adding Royal Quests and Basel Gorge for your enjoyment. 

[b]Royal Quests[/b]

Royal Quests are a new daily quest series that will be available to characters starting at level 45. Players will be able to find and accept these quests in multiple locations around the world; they will be marked by purple quest icons on the world map. Players will be able to complete a total of 15 Royal Quests per day to maximize their rewards—which we think they will want to do since these quests have better rewards than regular quests. Some of the possible rewards even include rare pets and mounts!

[b]Basel Gorge[/b]

Basal Gorge is the crux of the conflict between the Union and Hieron factions. As such, it is recommended that Basel Gorge be approached with a party of level 45 players.

Located to the east of where the Siege of Castra takes place, Basel Gorge has a wide variety of gameplay elements that players can take part in, including difficult bosses to take down (Spider Queen Akasys, Murderous Rover Sykeeli, and more), enemy bases to attack, and enemy troops to battle. With options for many kinds of play within Basel Gorge, we hope that all high-level players are able to enjoy this area as much as we do.

You can look forward to more details about Basel Gorge and Royal Quests being shared soon!

[h1]Market Improvements[/h1]

In addition to this new content, we are also going to be making some adjustments to improve the Market with the update on July 4th. We received your feedback that the Market was not functioning in the way that either you wanted or we intended, so we are making some changes to its functionality. Please let us know what you think of these changes once they have been implemented.

[b]Changes in the Market[/b]

Our goal with these changes is to prevent players from having difficulty using or from being unable to use the Market due to issues with item prices being raised to values that most players can’t afford to pay. We already implemented a first step in these changes on June 26nd which you can read about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1684792325780524895] here. [/url]

We have adjusted some of the standard prices of certain items that have been abnormally changed, and temporarily locked them so as to reach stability in the Market. We also temporarily increased the range of the minimum/maximum registration price and will leave it that way until the Market balance is improved.

[b]UI[/b]

In addition, we will also be making some improvements to the Market UI to make it more user friendly, and plan to display additional information about transactions that have been made and make other modifications to the UI according to the system changes.

We have even more updates planned for the near future, so stay tuned! We’re also still working on many improvements stemming from your feedback on balance, performance, bugs, and more. We look forward to hearing your feedback on these new changes and content.

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] Early Access Week 3 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b4ebfd96e1099f27ae7ceee4a68e6c65f6c1328d.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

In today’s letter we are going to mainly talk about servers; first about the stability issues that we encountered during the start of Bless Online’s Early Access, and second about the upcoming server consolidation.


[b]Server Stability During the Start of Early Access[/b]

When preparing to launch Bless in Early Access on Steam, we decided to use AWS for our servers based on our previous experience using it for 5+ years. We automated infrastructure configuration and server extensions, and from six months ago we tested AWS to verify server stability at varying levels of server load.
 
When Bless Online Early Access launched, the servers were initially able to provide stable service, and were supposed to be able to support up to 5000 CCU each. However, after a period of time, a problem developed with network connectivity, which posed a threat to service stability. Because of this, we opted to increase our total servers temporarily to help balance out the amount of players.

Immediately we began working to track down the root of the issue, and were able to ascertain that the problem was stemming from the ENA (Elastic Network Adapter) feature of AWS. We were able to address this issue by switching all server instance types to a previous generation that didn’t use ENA, and server stability has since increased. However, we will continue to collaborate with AWS to try and continually improve the reliability and performance of the Bless servers.


[b]Server Consolidation[/b]

Now that Early Access launch is over, in the coming weeks it will be time to consolidate the servers that we temporarily opened up to account for the influx of new players trying out the game. However, we will have servers ready and waiting for Bless Online’s full launch when we’ll need the space once again! Before the consolidations take place (we are currently aiming for the end of July), we will share with you all a detailed guide on how they will work. For now, here is an overview of the changes.

We will be consolidating into 2 NA servers and 2 EU servers; the remaining NA servers will be Kairos and Hilan, and the EU servers will be Bacillas and Iriaphos. The rest of the servers will be consolidated into these.

Before the consolidations are implemented, there will be a period of time where players will be able to prepare themselves for the consolidations. With the guide that we will provide at a later date closer to the consolidation, players will be able to plan ahead with their characters and know where they will be going, what items will be transferred where, and more. Additionally, after the consolidations take place, we are planning on adding the 70v70 Siege of Castra mode that you may have seen the preview for a couple weeks ago. 

We have heard many of you giving feedback and asking about server consolidations, and we hope that you will enjoy your experience in Bless even more after these changes have been made! As always, we will be working with AWS and our own engineers to provide stable, enjoyable servers for all our players.


[b]The 6/21 Game Update[/b]

On 6/21, we released a game update to address some of the balance issues with classes, which included reducing the frequency of the Paladin’s ability to use CC, buffing the ranger, and improving the Berserker’s DPS. You can read in detail about the changes in the patch notes here: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1684791781097199072]v1.2.0.0 Patch Note[/url] 

Please let us know what you think of these balance changes! We are working on other important issues such as dungeon balance, improved performance, Auction House functionality, and more. However, we hope you can enjoy this balance patch while we continue to make the Bless experience even better, and keep an eye out for more updates soon! 

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] Early Access Week 1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

It has been over a week since Bless Online's Early Access began, and the whole Bless Team including developers, customer support, and community have been very busy. We are also very thankful for all your feedback in the form of bugs, suggestions, and more. 

As we encountered various issues shortly after our first server opened, we did our best to address the situation and come up with solutions to implement as quickly as we could. 

However, as important as it is quickly solve individual issues, it is also important to share the current and future milestones of Bless Online with you so that we are all on the same page. We will continue to communicate with the community in order to improve our game all the way up to our official release. I will also continue to use the format of the Producer’s Letter to discuss Bless Online during Early Access.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/76475de5e28d8e956e69e8dfd8d5ac58f1b33942.jpg[/img]
First of all, we have reviewed all of your feedback regarding server stabilization, localization, monetization, game content, and more. As a result, we found that the biggest issues were server stabilization, client optimization and game content adjustments that differ from our originally intended game design. 

Last week, we updated the game with multiple patches for improved server stabilization and bug fixes. We plan to continue improving server stability in addition to catching any critical errors.
[quote]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264230347956496]v1.0.0.1 Patch Note[/url]: EA release specification
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264230350595935]v1.0.0.2 Patch Note[/url]: Quest item respawn time adjustment for smoother quest progression and bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683467427454]v1.0.0.3 Patch Note[/url]: Loading screen freeze fix and 5 other bugs fixes 
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683478321637]v1.0.0.4 Patch Note[/url]: Peninsula War update, first game balance adjustment and 5 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683485271253]v1.0.0.5 Patch Note[/url]: Quest tracker issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683490362953]v1.0.0.6 Patch Note[/url]: Peninsula War buff deletion issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683492670644]v1.0.0.7 Patch Note[/url]: Berserker stance skill issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683503492995]v1.0.0.8 Patch Note[/url]: second game balance adjustment, appearance change item with gender change, and 3 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1652139417423215149]v1.0.0.9 Patch Note[/url]: Fixed the NPC store selling price of a specific item and 3 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1652139417430110904]v1.0.1.0 Patch Note[/url]: Changes to Chain Bonus interruptions, field boss drop-table, and 6 other bug fixes
[/list]
[/quote]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c38d0412c8643a7ffff1b95d43cbd3743155588d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]1. Localization (L10N)[/b][/h1]
We are aware and agree with the community’s criticism regarding the poor quality of current localization. I’d like to inform you that the completion rate of the main storyline’s localization process is over 90%. However, just before EA, we realized that there were some serious localization errors in newly developed areas such as the tutorial, skills, and system messages, all of which could be found early on in the Steam version of the game. As a result, we decided put a stop to all localization projects and focus on language QA. 

We have improved the localization process and assigned dedicated personnel to the L10N team for higher quality results. We plan to improve and finalize the English text before starting to translate the English text into German. 

Below are some changes made to the live server last week. 
[quote]
[list]
[*]Corrected mistranslations in the NPC script
[*]Corrected mistranslations of skill names and synced all the UI terms (still work in progress)
[*]Corrected the level up phrase
[*]Corrected faction mistranslations in character creation
[*]Synced the terms found in the Spirit and Gear Score UI
[/list][/quote]
Our top priority right now is to increase the quality of the English translations and to eliminate player confusion caused by poorly translated text. As mistranslations can be patched without server maintenance, we will apply the new edited files to the client to as soon as they are available to  improve the quality of the translation.

[h1][b]2. Customer Support ticket delays[/b][/h1]
We unfortunately did not prepare enough infrastructure support or service personnel to meet the demands of players at the launch of Bless Online. The amount of inquiries and requests received through our customer support channel and Discord, and other channels was many  times more than what our customer service and community team could handle. We are well aware of this issue and are treating it with utmost importance. In order to quickly respond to the tickets, we have temporarily recruited customer support staff from other Neowiz projects.  For improved service in the long run, we are adding more dedicated staff to the team. We expect our speed of response rate to increase and normalize soon. 

[h1][b]3. Server performance improvements and game optimizations[/b][/h1]
Last week, we encountered serious issues that affected game connectivity and progression such as the loading screen freezing, server crashes, queues, and in-game delays. As a result, we carried out various performance improvements to solve these issues. 
[quote]
[list]
[*]Installed new servers without maintenance (there are currently 6 NA and 5 EU top-level servers).
[*]Upgraded the DB systems/storage to high-performance equipments to solve in-game delays.
[*]Increased cloud server capacity to solve queue issues.
[*]Improved stability by tuning server-to-server network connectivity.
[*]Switched to the previous generation AWS instance type to solve the network interface problems introduced by the latest AWS instance type.
[/list][/quote]
Our development team is currently looking for additional ways to improve performance, and will continue the optimization work through consistent monitoring and analysis. 


In addition to our original patch schedule, we are working hard to update our live servers right away every time a fix is prepared. As with scheduled patches, we aim to share detailed information through patch notes for each and every update. 

In addition to bug fixes and game optimization, we are also working to add new content ahead of schedule for players to enjoy.
Soon we'll be updating Bless with the “Siege of Castra” battlefield that was introduced in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1652139417423239914][EA Update Preview #2 - Siege of Castra][/url]. We look forward to receiving your feedback on the new content when it becomes available, and I wish you all victory on the battlefield. 

Sincerely,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: EA Update Preview #2 - Siege of Castra
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/55074d08960f1af82b7fce7b5fce2a7917320a98.jpg[/img]


Greetings! 

Following the Peninsular War, we are excited to introduce more new updates! The Siege of Castra, a large-scale battlefield that pitches a max of 70 players from each faction (140 in total!) against each other will be available to players soon. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9c0f46c561f83dfbda6d3be251fbcab220d2dc26.jpg[/img]

Players above level 25 will be able to participate in the Siege of Castra by going to their System Menu (ESC)>  War (B)> Battlefield List. Once players have entered the battlefield, they will be able to prepare for the official start of the war in either the Hieron or the Union military headquarters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/919aeddf23c00df00b72a91ee50d1cbc8cf9ad69.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b73b83a95ad6c61c743cff977478a1d3419cba4.jpg[/img]

The war lasts for 30 minutes, and victory can be achieved by defeating the enemy commander who is located in the opposing faction’s military headquarters. However, it is not easy to infiltrate each faction's fortress. (If neither side is able to eliminate the opposing faction’s commander, the war will end in a tie.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/67928c56aa7e9c2dc4672d62817a8f11ce7add9f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5ef2491e6f03ebbfd0554acabcdc70a7cd143b29.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1b5b8a95ad2df769f4a1593727544642fe2b1c05.jpg[/img]

There is a “Purifying Tree” located by the road in the middle of the battlefield that can greatly help your allies advance; players must be careful not to let it be taken by the enemy faction. The key to victory is to adapt a unified yet swift attack tactic through forming a raid party and appointing a leader who will lead the faction. 

[h1]Purifying Tree (Middle Road)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If players succeed in taking over the tree, a vindictive spirit that attacks the enemy’s military headquarters will be released.
    [*]As the vindictive spirit is unstoppable while it charges towards the fortress gates, players should be swift to claim the Purifying Tree for their faction or risk having the vindictive spirit arrive at their own base.
    [*]The vindictive spirit will soon head for the faction commander once the fortress gates fall.
[/list]
[h1]Guardian Stone (Left and right paths)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If either faction claims the Purifying Tree and seizes the vindictive spirit, then a Guardian Stone will appear on either the left or right path.
    [*]If players manage to completely deplete the Guardian Stone HP, the vindictive spirit controlled by the enemy faction will disappear. 
    [*]The faction that failed to claim the Purifying Tree before their enemies must decide whether they will directly eliminate the vindictive spirit themselves, or if they will do so through the Guardian Stone. 
[/list]
[h1]Defensive Equipment (Faction Military Headquarters)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]There are 4 mobile artillery located in front of the gates of each faction’s military headquarters to help fend off invading enemies. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/0e01d67eaa3b3b98abc232544ac6cc7752af1953.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7519da78943a84dc65e1dd88ca166d3bcaaeac4e.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/24ed17d573e78b0699177929e07d027d766238f0.jpg[/img]

Rankings in the Siege of Castra are determined by activity points, though players can also earn medals by completing achievements. The final reward will be determined by the activity point score and medals earned.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ad9bce7993139f301dac1b850e8a16c948cd52b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reward for playing the Siege of Castra once[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If victory is achieved (the player's faction successfully eliminated the enemy commander): Maximum of 400 Combat Points, 100 Quest Performance Points 
    [*] If it ends in a tie (Neither faction was able to defeat the opposing faction’s commander before time ran out): Maximum of 200 Combat Points, 75 Quest Performance Points
    [*]If defeated: Maximum of 150 Combat Points, 35 Quest Performance Points
[/list]
[h1]Siege of Castra Quest Completion Reward[/h1]
[list]
    [*]700 Combat Points, 30 Crystallized Magical Power
[/list]

More details regarding the Siege of Castra and its update schedule will be announced in a later patch note. The Siege of Castra will soon be available! 

Who will lead their faction to victory? 
Start preparing now!

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] Update on duplication bug issue
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

We have taken additional actions regarding the duplication bug since the first announcement was made. After monitoring the situation for some time, we’re now able to confirm that the duplication bug is completely fixed.

[b][Technical measure][/b]
We were able to identify an issue where, while under heavy server loads, timeouts would occur while using the Market. We have implemented a varied approach when resolving this issue. Steps have been taken to minimize the frequency of timeouts while using the Market, and additional checks have also been added to each transaction to verify that a transaction is only being processed once.

Since implementing this fix, we have not seen a recurrence of the duplication bug on the Market. We will also continue to monitor the Market activities for any further signs of bug abuse.

[b][Additional actions][/b]
We have taken action against the accounts of players that have abused this bug and retrieved all of the duplicated items. In case the items had been already used, the equivalent gold amount of these acquired items have been removed instead. Players have also been banned and / or warned due to their actions.

Neowiz and the Bless Online team take exploits very seriously and strive to maintain a level playing field for all players.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

    [*]Adjusted some classes’ skill effects
[/olist]
Please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1653264683503492995][u]patch note for more details. (v1.0.0.8 Patch Note)[/u][/url]



[h1][b]Future Update Plan[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*][b]Ranger Balance Patch[/b]
We will be applying patch v1.0.0.8, which reduces the Ranger’s utilities’ cooldown time. We are also aware that there are additional issues, and we plan to fix these in an additional patch as adjusting the Ranger class is a high priority right now. 

    [*][b]Other Classes’ Balance Patches[/b]
Balance modifications will not end with just this patch. We plan to continue with other class balances in stages. 

    [*][b]Patch regarding the conditions that cuts off the Chain Bonus[/b]
The Chain Bonus cuts off in the following situations:
[table]
[tr]
	[th]NOW[/th]
	[th]AFTER CHAIN BONUS PATCH[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]miss, dodge, resist, immune[/td]
	[td]miss[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

The higher the hit rating, the less “misses” there will be. As this is dependent on the player, the current rule will not be modified. However, as dodge, resist, and immune are defenses on the side of the enemy, they will no longer break Chain Bonuses as there is nothing you can do attack-wise that will prevent the chain from breaking. This patch will soon be applied. 

    [*][b]Action Targeting Mode[/b]
Lastly, I present to you our plans for the action targeting mode. During the development process, we found that we cannot guarantee optimal control of the action targeting mode for all classes, except for the Berserker. We plan to make it possible for other classes to use action targeting as soon as we solve these gameplay problems (except for the Paladin class which will only have tab-targeting). However, this adjustment is currently pushed back as we are focusing on stabilization and balance. We will provide you with more information once we have determined a time frame for the action targeting mode update. 
[/olist]

We really appreciate the quick and clear feedback we have been getting from the community; we always want to address issues players find as quickly and effectively as possible. Please continue to share your thoughts and ideas with us! With your help we will do our best to quickly find the best direction for Bless Online. 

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: EA Update Preview #1 - New BattleField : Peninsular War
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1cf1e04f0fe803aaf4119391f7e7539c9dfcc1fa.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

It is my pleasure to introduce to you our small-scale RvR content “Peninsular War”, which will be introduced to Bless Online today.  

The Peninsular War is a small battlefield located by the beautiful tropical southern peninsula. A total of 30 players (15 from each Hieron and Union) may join the Peninsular War, which was created so that players can experience the fun of battlefield combat with elaborate strategies and a small amount of players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4b9d38bca3f05645064a6823cac7694907a37cee.jpg[/img]

If you want to try out the Peninsular War go to [u]Menu(Esc)>War(b)>Battlefield List then Peninsula War[/u]. Once both faction’s team matching is complete you will be able to enter the battlefield. There will be 2-3 minutes of waiting time before the battle officially begins. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/18769daf13c18926def28a7b97284ce4b35b57e8.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/55e9308d5e193fe943e29c147499e2a748ca85eb.jpg[/img]

The basic rules are simple. On the battlefield there are 4 bases and 1 special base. Points are earned every time players capture a base. Although acquiring points is important, deciding on which base to capture is also as critical to victory as your character will resurrect at the nearest base. 

The faction that acquires 20,000 points first within the 15-25 time limit wins, but if time runs out before either side reaches 20,000 points, victory is awarded to the side with more points. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/052f810705f9977be7b1fadac1796fbbfc1dda34.jpg[/img]

Although the Peninsular War is comparably small-scaled battlefield, there are many topographical features that can be used strategically. If you want to win, you need to decide on whether your team is going to split up and attack multiple bases all at once, or if you are going to band together and target a specific base. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7f3b00ba5e1fbe7374c4770d34155cae61db93f3.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4ea36b7b4e135dee04ef92705fcee8a94db00194.jpg[/img]

However, as we understand that it can be boring to always play with the same rules. Therefore we came up with ways to prevent our players from being tired of Peninsular War. Although the core rules will be the same, there may be different rules per week, and topographical features such as poison swamps and sky bridges depending on the season level rotation system. Victory will be decided by how well players make use of them to win. 

[h1] Season Level Rotation System [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Season 1: Useful items will be scattered around the battlefield.
    [*]Season 2: There will be neutral mobs that you can “turn into allies” around the battlefield
    [*]Season 3: A sky bridge that allows players to quickly get to important bases 
    [*]Season 4: The mana consumption and cooltime of all skills used will be reduced. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b2521e394c69bb9ed7e68e28cf42636ae514fa1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ba6e4be70c836f5e34db45d46260888999dab5bf.jpg[/img]

Combat Points are awarded to all participants of the Peninsular War regardless of whether their faction won or lost. Additional rewards can be acquired by completing daily quests (once per day).

[h1] Rewards [/h1][list]
[*] Victory: 700 Combat Points
[*] Defeat: 100 Combat Points
[*] Completes Peninsular War’s Daily Quest: 300 Combat Points
[list]
[*]Successfully carries out the Quest: 75 Participation Points
[*]Fails the Quest: 35 Participation Points
[/list]
[/list]※ Players can use combat points to purchase useful items at the Special Currency Shop.


We hope you will enjoy a unique battlefield in Bless Online every week!

Thank You,
The Bless Team

notes.title: An Apology and Update from the Producer on Bless Online’s Status
notes.notes:
Greetings!

This is Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer.

[h1]The entire Bless Team and I would like to express our deepest gratitude to all the Founders for your support shown since our Advanced Access on May 28th.[/h1]

I would like to address the connection, login, and server crash issues from the large influx of players that some of you have been experiencing. First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize to everyone who participated our Head Start as Founders for the recent issues which resulted in long waits and many inconveniences.

[u]The entire development team is committed to identifying and addressing the causes of current performance issues and we are doing our best to solve them as our TOP PRIORITY. [/u]

[h1]What we have been doing:[/h1]
[list]
[*]We prepared three NA servers and two EU servers for our Advanced Access, but the number of players increased very rapidly and all three NA servers were maxed out in the first three hours of AA. While this was happening, it was difficult for us to add more servers as quickly as you expected and it led to the waiting queue. Now we have expanded to six NA servers and four EU servers.

[*]There was also a recurring client crash caused by using Player Duels in-game. We identified the cause and resolved it. 

[*]The issue with the launcher loading stopping at 40% or being delayed is now fixed. 
[/list]

[h1]What about the many issues remaining? Here is what will be fixed with the (V1.0.0.3) update which is being applied today, May 30th.[/h1]
[list]
[*]The issue with getting stuck on the “BLESS” loading screen issues has now been fixed. Authentication failure was identified as the issue between STEAM and BLESS servers when players attempted to log-in. We will closely monitor the situation after the patch.

[*]We experienced database I/O delay due to the large influx of players. This caused a lot of the lag you experienced with looting, quests, and other actions. With the urgent maintenance, we upgraded database system/storage to top-end models in order to solve I/O delay. This should improve the lag players see during crowded server times.

[*]For Early Access, we prepared an additional six NA servers and five EU servers that can be added instantly without maintenance. In addition, we reinforced our in-game logs to help identify the cause of server crash issues. 

[/list]
Again, I would like to sincerely apologize to all the players who experienced any inconveniences due to server problems or connection errors. We will be a development team that communicates with you.

We know that these issues are just a few of the things that need to be worked on with the Early Access of Bless Online. We chose the Early Access format on Steam because the development and release of content for Bless will be a many-layered process throughout the EA period. We understand that many players are disappointed that not all of the content they expected to be in at Early Access launch is there.
 
Along with the performance issues, our top priority is addressing[u] the reported potential item duplication bug[/u]. Once we can replicate this issue and solve it, we will let all of our players know. 
 
Most importantly, we know that there is end-game content missing that many of you expected in this first Early Access build, given what’s available in the other versions of the game. [u]Additions like the 15v15 PVP and new high-level dungeons will be added in 1-2 weeks’ time[/u], with more to come soon after.
 
Bless Online’s Early Access was always intended to be a growing experience, with systems and content being added in the weeks and months ahead; this is why we chose the Steam Early Access program. We are sincerely sorry that our players were led to believe otherwise, and we are happy to allow refunds for those who feel they cannot wait for the new content to arrive. We hope that you will return to the world of Bless when the features you expect are in the game and ready for your participation. 

Sincerely,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer


EDIT: We realized the wording about Bless refunds was previously ambiguous. We have now clarified the text to make more apparent the fact that refunds must adhere to Steam’s own refund policy.

notes.title: Bless Online v1.0.0.1 EA release spec notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/eb2860a35909b1e9ffec4ea9ddee7abac5d164a5.jpg[/img]
The Bless Online v1.0.0 EA version will be released on May 30, 2018.
The key specs of Bless Online v1.0.0.1 EA are given below.

[h1][b][Basic information][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Levels and Character Creation[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]The maximum level is level 45.
[*]Each server supports 4 free character slots, plus 2 additional slots unlockable with Lumena.
[*]Character and guild names must be between 2-12 characters. Names can only contain alphabetical characters and digits.
[*]Basic inventory has 48 slots + 16 additional slots available through quests or are unlockable with Lumena.
[/list]

[i][b]Races and Classes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Classes: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Factions and races:
[list]
[*]Unión: Amistad, Pantera, Aqua Elf, Mascu
[*]Hieron: Habicht, Lupus, Sylvan Elf, Mascu
[/list]
[*]Selectable classes by race
[list]
[*]Amistad/Habicht: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Pantera/Lupus: Guardian, Berserker, Ranger
[*]Aqua Elf/Sylvan Elf: Guardian, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Mascu: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[/list]
[*]Selectable targeting modes by class
[list]
[*]Tab-targeting: Mage, Ranger, Paladin, Guardian
[*]Action-targeting: Berserker
[/list]
[/list]

[i][b]Major Currencies[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Dungeon Points: These can be obtained from dungeons and Hunt Quests.
[*]Combat Points: These can be obtained from PVP combat or other PVP content.
[*]Gold: This can be obtained from monster hunting and quests. 
[*]Lumena: This can be obtained by exchanging Dungeon Points and/or Combat Points, or purchased with cash.
[/list]

[h1][b][Quests][/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/068cfe441a4b48fdf0c22d36780e7be30d9d1691.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial Zone & The Pathfinder of Adventure[/b]
[list]A separate training ground for beginners. Users can learn how to use the Bless interface, key systems, and content, and claim rewards. [/list]
[*][b]The Footprints of Destiny (Main Quests)[/b]
[list]The Footprints of Destiny is the main story quest line in Bless, and is based on the faction and race of your character. As the story grows along with your character, it is necessary to follow this quest. [/list]
[*][b]Memories of Journey (Side Quests)[/b]
[list]The Memories of Journey are episodic quests that can be carried out in different regions. These additional stories are separate from the main Bless storyline, allowing you to experience various episodes that took place throughout the continent through memories of the past. [/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 10.[/i][/list]
[*][b]Hunt Quests[/b]
[list]These are quests to hunt a certain number of a particular monster type. Complete these quests to earn Dungeon Points.[/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 10.[/i][/list]
[*][b]Missions[/b]
[list]Missions are performance goals which can be completed on a daily or weekly basis. Completing them will grant EXP and rewards. The progress goals and rewards are different depending on the character level. [/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 7.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[h1][b][PVP content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Combat Class[/b][/i]
Depending on your PvP results and your contribution to battle, you will acquire EXP and Combat Points. Merit is determined by the Combat Points earned by the character over the past seven days, and Combat Class is calculated by comparing the Merit earned over the past 4 weeks with the determined Merit. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5eb7aaa340aaf186abc9041d0c153e58b7d78593.jpg[/img]
[i]* Combat Class compensation for Combat Points: Every Tuesday at 1:00 AM[/i]
[i]* You can obtain Gem Fragments when using medals.[/i]


[h1][b][PVE content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Field Bosses [/b][/i]
In the open field, there are boss monsters that require 20 Raid Party members to defeat. They appear in one of 7 neutral areas in an 18-hour cycle.
* Appearance areas: Wyvern Valley 1, Wyvern Valley 2, Dustbowl, White Desert, Vachel, Wyvern Valley 3, North of Saltus
    
[i][b]Dungeons[/b][/i]
There are dungeons throughout the Bless world where you can battle powerful monsters that are difficult to encounter in the field. You can enter these dungeons if you have the required level and Gear Score.
[i]* Dungeon Play Count will be reset every day at 1:00 AM. [/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ca0d35660d0b8d02dbba05c218acdac17cf65e0c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][Non-combat content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Companions [/b][/i]
Around 600 tamable monsters inhabit the world of Bless. 
Depending on your character and Taming level, you'll be able to tame up to 200 monsters.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/f7dbc10bdd8697e636d2d1fac5e8fc711b9b3a86.jpg[/img]

You can obtain mounts and pets via taming. You can try to tame most monsters in the field, and you can improve them through Upgrading and Enhancement once the monster is successfully tamed.  
[list]
[*][b]Taming Method[/b]
[list]You can start a Taming mini-game by using an appropriate Taming Scroll on the target monster. You will acquire a new Companion if you succeed. There is a small chance of a Great Success mini-game occurring, allowing you to acquire a higher level Companion depending on the probability of success.[/list]

[i][b]Enhancement and Upgrading[/b][/i]
[list]You can increase the EXP of pets and mounts by Enhancement. Whenever a pet's EXP gauge reaches 100%, the pet's level increases by 1. When you reach the maximum level in each grade, you can increase the grade of pets and mounts through Upgrading, in the order [b][Magical] - [Rare] - [Heroic] - [Legendary][/b]. [/list]
[/list]

[i][b]Gathering/Mining[/b][/i]
You can acquire items for crafting through gathering and mining. You'll need a Gathering Bag to gather plants, and a Pickaxe to mine ore.
[list][*]Let's Gather Dungeon: A single player dungeon that allows you to collect minerals, grain, etc. freely for a limited time. You can enter the dungeon via 'Rand Brother Turban', who appears randomly in the fields of Bless.[/list]

[i][b]Crafting[/b][/i]
You can craft a new item using materials and recipes acquired through various routes.
The crafting system is classified as below, and 1 skill in each category can be selected.
[list]
[*]Main Crafting: Armorsmithing, Handiwork, Enchanting
[*]Sub Crafting: Secret, Cooking, Alchemy 
[/list]
You can use workshops or universal workbenches for crafting. Every time you craft, your Craft Points increase. The higher your Craft Points, the higher your crafting level. A higher crafting level provides more crafting benefits.


[h1][b][Combat skills][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Skill Growth [/b][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/f85bc7e095d00f58263d8b3e7173e04e074e712a.jpg[/img]
You can choose 2 Stance-Chain Skills and 4 Non-Chain skills to perform combat moves. You can choose whether to continue the Stance-Chain skill's 3 to 4 combo sets to maintain the skill's enhanced effects, or use Non-Chain skills to obtain instant utility.

Skill types are divided as follows, 
[list]
[*]Stance: A state that can be assumed during battle. Effects are granted according to Stance duration and conversion. It includes the Stance-Chain Skill that follows the sequence of Starting Skill > Link Skill > Finish Skill.
[*]Non-Chain skill: Utility skill immediately available regardless of stance state. 
[/list]
[i][b]Skill Acquisition and Growth System[/b][/i]
Characters can automatically acquire skills according to their level.     
Skill growth is possible via Gem items.
There are three types of Gems, which can be obtained through the leveling process. Gems can be assembled from the 'Gem Fragment' item, obtained from quests and field monsters.

There are three types of Gems – Stance-Chain, Non-Chain, and parameter – and these are used to grow skill nodes of each type.     
    

[h1][b][Items][/b][/h1]

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/428996a27b838f0b8761b6dd7a645cf305e67717.jpg[/img]
Items are categorized into 6 ratings: Misc, Common, Magical, Rare, Heroic, and Legendary; the higher the rating, the higher its ability and effect. Items can be upgraded and managed.
[list]
[*][b]Equipment Enhancement/Transcended Enhancement[/b]
You can strengthen your equipment with Equipment Enhancement Machines found in the capital of each faction. As well as the equipment to be enhanced, you'll need Enhancement materials and Enhancement sub-materials. Enhancement failure can result in loss of enhancement materials, and a decrease in the Enhancement step and maximum durability of the equipment. 
When the Enhancement step reaches 15, you can attempt Transcended Enhancement in order to add a special option or a Spirit slot in addition to increased ability.
[*][b]Equipment Succession[/b]
Transcended Enhancements in equipment can be transferred to higher-level equipment through enhancement succession. Succession will transfer the Transcended level to the new item, but there is a chance that the Enhancement level will be reduced. You will need an additional Essential Material to perform a Succession.
[*][b]Equipment Repair/Durability[/b]
Weapons and armor have a durability which is reduced in the following cases. Reduced durability can be restored via repair tools or blacksmith NPCs in a capital city or camp. However, the maximum durability may be reduced if an Enhancement or repair attempt fails.
[*][b]Dismantling Items[/b]
Certain items, including equipment, can be dismantled via Dismantling Machines found in various locations. Dismantling an item can yield various items depending on the item classification and Enhancement state.
[*][b]Spirits[/b]
You can increase your character's ability by imbuing your armor with a Spirit. Spirits are divided into offensive and defensive types, and each of them has 3 levels. Spirits added to armor can be destroyed in the following situations.
[/list]
[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9e9aaf0d4e3e3c63aa4f475623eca2b82a4fce6d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1][b][Major communities][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Friends [/b][/i]
You can add characters to your friends list if they are members of the same faction.
If they are registered as friends, it is easier to check their online status, chat and form a party. 

[i][b]Parties/Party Effects[/b][/i]
Players from the same faction can form a party of up to 5 members. Party members can raid dungeons together, or kill monsters too difficult to face alone. Also, if you play in a party, you can benefit from combat and lifestyle buff effects.

[i][b]Raid Parties[/b][/i]
A party extension feature that supports up to 20 players in deploying effective tactics together.
When a party is formed, the party leader can switch it to a Raid Party.

[i][b]Guilds[/b][/i]
A guild is a group of people who want to make friends and share the same goals in the game. You can create or join a guild under certain conditions. Guilds can be created via the guild manager NPC located in towns or villages belonging to each faction. When creating a guild, you must apply as a party with 1 or more other players who are not already members of a guild (2 or more players in total including yourself).
[list][*]Guild Influence/Guild Level
You can gain Guild Influence through the specific activities of guild members. The total accumulated Guild Influence represents the Guild Experience, and the Guild Level increases based on Guild Experience. Guild Influence is updated daily at 1:00 AM and automatically disappears if the guild is disbanded.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9e4e4e1497c211669642af9923cbdb1491a6eb4a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][Main features][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Market[/b][/i]
A place where you can sell items to other players or purchase items you need.
You can view the market products in the system menu, but to actually buy/sell items, you'll need to visit Sarara, the market manager NPC, in the capital of either faction.
You can enter any price within the standard price range for each item, with an upper and lower limit of 25%. The basic sales tax rate is 15%.
Items purchased with Lumena, items with the "not for trade" attribute, and pet/mount items cannot be traded.

[i][b]Special Currency Shop[/b][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b79385fe2a2b6bd38165d96fe8a12761bde91b9.jpg[/img]
In the Special Currency Shop, you can purchase various items using Bless currencies such as Lumena and Activity Points (Combat Points and Dungeon Points). Purchased items can be found in the inventory.
-	Lumena Category: Character costumes/mount/pet appearance changes, functional extensions, convenience items, etc.
-	Combat Point Category: Regular items, equipment succession, Enhancement-related material items, etc.
-	Dungeon Point Category: Enhancement sub-material items for pets and mounts 

[i][b]Lumena Exchange[/b][/i]
Activity Points (Combat Points and Dungeon Points) can be exchanged for up to 50 Lumena a day.

[i][b]Account Inbox/Mail[/b][/i]
You can check the acquired items from the Steam Inventory via your Account Inbox. When you receive an item from the Account Inbox, it will be moved to mail. Once you receive the item from your mail, you will see it in the inventory window. 
You can exchange items between characters on the same account via the mailbox. All items that can be registered on the market are attachable. 
 
[i][b]Personal Warehouses[/b][/i]
You can use a personal warehouse for each character in your account, where you can store up to 48 items.
Personal warehouses can be accessed via personal warehouse managers located in the large cities of each faction.

notes.title: [Dev Talk #03] Key Changes in Bless Online’s Steam Release
notes.notes:
Greetings!

As we march towards the May release of Bless Online on Steam, many of you asked how the Steam version of Bless Online is going to be different from its past or currently available releases. We definitely understand where the questions are coming from. We have not shared as much as we should have in explaining how the game will be different from what you see in Korea or Japan servers. That’s why we decided to focus this blog on describing some of the key changes we are bringing to the Steam release. 

While we’ve been developing Bless Online for a long time, our focus on making Bless Online a great game has never wavered. We also have an amazing and active community that has not given up on us but continue to support us and give constructive feedback. One of the primary goals for the Steam release is to make sure to address some of the key concerns that have been repeatedly raised by the community. Now, let’s explore what some of those changes are.

[h1]Combat System Restructuring[/h1]
[b][u]Let’s change everything we can![/u][/b]
We spent the most effort in revamping the combat system! We’ve re-examined almost every class’ skills and restructured their composition and effects.

[b]Rhythmic Combat[/b]
[list]
[*]Players need to pick two stance skills out of six, as well as four general skills that will go well with their class. Using these skills in combos during combat will lead to extra effects (1. Select a stance, 2. Use your starting skill 3. Use a skill combo).

[*]In combat, there is more action and it has gotten more difficult due to the new dynamic combo system. Depending on how good a player is at making combos, they can bring out the full potential of their class.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4e2ae5d59ac5501d96deeef2d60e27332c4c30a8.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[b]Restructuring Growth Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*]We have rebuilt the mechanics behind both skill acquisition and skill leveling. In the Steam version, in addition to advancing your equipment, learning and leveling up skills are main parts of growing your character.  

[*]There is a variety of ways to obtain the gems that are used to level skills. As we aim to avoid P2W, the amount of money you spend on the game will not affect the amount of gems you can get.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ae94978d5557eca0fae4bed8fcffecffd371f684.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[h1]Party Buffs[/h1]
[b][u]Join a party for the full Bless experience![/u][/b]
[list]
[*]We believe that the best way to enjoy any MMORPG is by playing with others. As an incentive for players to play the game with a variety of people, we have decided to introduce party benefits!

[*]Depending on the number of members, classes, and races of the party members, the party leader can choose one combat effect and one lifestyle (non-combat) effect from a selection to be applied to party members! 

[*]With this feature we hope that not only those who enjoy combat, but also those who prefer the lifestyle (non-combat) aspects of MMORPGs can enjoy playing with other players! 

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ea75e40969c5dadf6314d8ee9932137879aeea7b.jpg[/img]
[i] (The screenshots above were taken during the development process and therefore are not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[h1]User Friendly Monetization[/h1]
[b][u]Everyone will love our in-game shops![/u][/b]
Along with having no P2W in the Steam version, Bless Online’s monetization system will be user friendly. 
[list] 

[*]Content token shop: We have designed it so that players can use content tokens (special in-game currency earned by just playing the game) to purchase functional items.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b9e6a64c502d8006a895dce61e1e8fb979c7e5c2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Lumena shop: Players can use Lumena (in-game currency purchased using real money) to buy a variety of  convenience and cosmetic items.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/33a801c46e85f8e32549345ee4d05897ffb31f58.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[list]
[*]Also, with the addition of the Lumena Exchange Center (name is WIP), players will be able to convert their content tokens into Lumena. This feature will allow even players who only buy the game (and nothing more!) the ability to use the Lumena shop to purchase convenience and cosmetic items.

[/list]

[h1]The Upgraded Bless Experience [/h1]
[b][u]A better paced path for Bless![/u][/b]

[b]Tutorial Zone[/b]
[list]

[*]Many new players reported that they did not have the best experience playing Bless due to the game being designed with experienced MMORPG players in mind. 

[*]In the Steam version, there will be a new area specifically for new players to practice basic skills. Those who are experienced MMORPG players or who already know the basics can skip this, but even if you skip or complete the tutorial, you can always go back to it.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/42c17c34e3614677cb31c3247cfb5aa02cb3f62c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1c01e46e1d82903c0141aeb1632f59156536f380.jpg[/img]

[b]Guide Quests [/b]
[list]
[*]These quests will teach you things the tutorial does not.
[*]They are much easier to understand than the pre-existing introductory quests.
[/list]

[b]Improved Content Pacing[/b]
[list]
[*]In Bless, players can take part in most activities even if they are only level 1. As a result, some new users reported difficulty in knowing where they are supposed to start.
[*]To address this, we have improved the pacing at which users are exposed to new content so that they can adjust to Bless in stages instead of being overwhelmed right from the beginning.
[/list]

[b]Upgraded Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*]In Bless, players level up through PvE combat and by experiencing a variety of events. As much of the PvE combat was relatively easy and repetitive, most players were quickly bored.
[*]In order to solve this problem, we have updated the mobs with special skills. We are also currently developing more features that will make leveling up an exciting adventure!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ae8bacb3bd14ef898bdeebfc8144d463b10a43.jpg[/img]
We are hopeful that these changes will allow our players to further enjoy Bless Online and have an exceptional overall experience. If you are interested in testing these key features for yourself, make sure you don’t miss Bless Online’s early access in May!  

Thank you,
The Bless Team
